sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza na Kujibu (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusikiliza mahojiano,
kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kujibu mahojiano,
kusikiliza mahojiano kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua vipengele vya kusikiliza na kujibu mahojiano vilivyozingatiwa,
kuwawasilishia wenzake vipengele vya kusikiliza na kujibu mahojiano vilivyozingatiwa katika mahojiano aliyosikiliza katika kifaa cha kidijitali,
kushiriki mahojiano kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa na wenzake, mzazi au mlezi kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya kusikiliza na kujibu mahojiano.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vipengele vipi vinavyofaa kuzingatiwa katika kusikiliza mahojiano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotumia vipengele vifaavyo kujieleza katika mahojiano akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kama vile simu, redio au kanda za sauti kusikilizia mahojiano mbalimbali ili kutambua vipengele vya usikilizaji faafu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapopendekeza vipengele sahihi vya kuzingatia na kuvitumia katika kusikiliza na kujibu mahojiano.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mahojiano na kujieleza kwa ukakamavu. Pia anapochangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mahojiano na wenzake, mzazi au mlezi na kujifunza njia bora za kusikiliza na kujibu mahojiano.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kuzungumza katika mahojiano bila kuwakata kauli.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika mazungumzo.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Masuala ya afya na mazingira: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusikiliza na kujibu mahojiano aliyojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usafi wa sehemu za umma na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

skills.name: Sikiliza na ujibu mahojiano ipasavyo
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (mahojiano), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on usafi wa soko la mji, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 listened and replied in conversation.
Grade 7 asked for and gave information.

misconceptions.error: Asks only yes/no questions in an interview.

example.question: Ni swali lipi bora la mahojiano?
example.correct_answer: Kazi yako ya kusafisha mji ina changamoto zipi?

misconceptions.cause: Yes/no questions are the easiest to make.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni swali lipi bora la mahojiano?" with "Unapenda kazi yako?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Turn each yes/no question into a "nini, vipi, kwa nini" question.
misconceptions.feedback: Uliza maswali yanayomfanya mhojiwa aeleze.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Starts the interview without greeting and introducing himself and the purpose.

example.question: Mahojiano huanza vipi?
example.wrong_answer: swali la kwanza moja kwa moja

misconceptions.cause: The child goes straight to the questions.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mahojiano huanza vipi?" with "swali la kwanza moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Script the opening together.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa salamu, jitambulishe, eleza lengo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Interrupts the speaker before he finishes.

example.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child fears losing his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?" with "mkatize ili usisahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Note the idea on paper; wait for the pause.
misconceptions.feedback: Msikilize mzungumzaji hadi amalize.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or English words in a formal talk.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?

misconceptions.cause: The child talks as with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?" with "Ma-guys, hii issue ni serious." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record and replay; replace each non-Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu cha simulizi kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kudondoa habari mahususi (k.v. nani? nini? wapi? lini?) katika kifungu cha simulizi,
kupanga matukio yanavyofuatana katika kifungu cha simulizi,
kufanya utabiri na ufasiri kutokana na kifungu cha simulizi alichosoma,
kutambua msamiati (k.v. maneno na nahau) katika kifungu cha simulizi na kuueleza kwa kutumia kamusi,
kusoma vifungu vya simulizi mtandaoni au kwenye vitabu kuhusu suala lengwa,
kutambua na kueleza maana ya msamiati wa usafi wa sehemu za umma kulingana na muktadha wa matumizi katika vifungu vya simulizi alivyosoma mtandaoni,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi sentensi kuhusu usafi wa sehemu za umma kisha wajadiliane umuhimu wa kudumisha usafi wa mazingira ya umma.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, tunapataje habari mahususi katika kifungu cha simulizi?
Je, ni mambo gani yanayoweza kukusaidia kuelewa kifungu cha simulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili na kudondoa habari mahususi kutoka kwenye kifungu alichosoma.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotumia msamiati wa suala lengwa kwa usahihi katika muktadha maalum.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapobashiri na kufasiri kutokana na kifungu cha ufahamu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni na kusoma vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Pia anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa.
Masuala ya afya na mazingira: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa na kuzingatia ujumbe.

misconceptions.error: Answers a "why" question with a "what" (an event, not its reason).

example.question: Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?
example.correct_answer: kwa sababu aliogopa mbwa wa jirani

misconceptions.cause: The child finds the sentence with the words of the question and copies the event.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?" with "alikimbia nyumbani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the question word: nini, nani, wapi, lini, kwa nini; the answer must fit it.
misconceptions.feedback: Swali la "kwa nini" hujibiwa kwa sababu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Orders the events as they are told in the question or the options, not as they happen in the passage.

example.question: Ni tukio lipi lilitokea kwanza katika kifungu?

misconceptions.cause: The order of the options is taken for the order of the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tukio lipi lilitokea kwanza katika kifungu?" with "tukio lililotajwa kwanza katika swali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the events in the margin of the passage before looking at the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa matukio katika kifungu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts with no clue from the passage, from what he wishes would happen.

example.question: Kutokana na kifungu, nini kitatokea baadaye?
example.correct_answer: jibu linalotokana na vidokezo vya kifungu

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as imagination.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kutokana na kifungu, nini kitatokea baadaye?" with "mhusika atakuwa tajiri sana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Every prediction needs a clue: "kwa sababu kifungu kinasema..."
misconceptions.feedback: Utabiri hutokana na vidokezo vya kifungu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the meaning of a look-alike word, or the everyday meaning where the passage means another.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "kupiga" katika "alipiga simu" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows one meaning and does not test it against the sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika kifungu, neno "kupiga" katika "alipiga simu" lina maana gani?" with "kumpiga mtu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put each meaning into the sentence; keep the one that fits.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutegemea sentensi lilimo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viakifishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
learning_experiences: kutambua alama ya hisi na ritifaa katika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwenye matini andishi na za kidijitali,
kuandika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia alama ya hisi na ritifaa ipasavyo kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika kwenye tarakilishi, kifungu kifupi kwa kutumia alama ya hisi na ritifaa ipasavyo na kuwasambazia wenzake kwenye mtandao ili wakitolee maoni,
kusahihisha kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa ambacho hakijatumia alama ya hisi na ritifaa ipasavyo,
kuwasomea wenzake kifungu alichoandika na kuwataka waandike maneno, sentensi au vifungu vinavyofaa kutumia alama ya hisi na ritifaa,
kumwonyesha mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake maneno, vifungu vya maneno au sentensi zenye alama ya hisi na ritifaa alizotunga ili atoe maoni yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, alama ya hisi huonyesha hisia zipi?
Je, alama ya ritifaa hutumiwa vipi katika maandishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuwasomea kifungu alichokiandika.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika kifungu na kukisambaza mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika vifungu vyenye matumizi yafaayo ya alama ya hisi na ritifaa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomwonyesha mzazi au mlezi wake maneno, vifungu vya maneno na sentensi ambazo zina alama ya hisi na ritifaa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Masuala ya afya na mazingira: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia alama ya hisi na ritifaa ipasavyo.

skills.name: Tofautisha sauti /gh/ na /g/ katika silabi, maneno na vitanzandimi
skills.mastery: Hears, says and writes the right sound in syllables and words with /gh/ na /g/ (ghali and gali, lugha and luga), picks the word that matches the meaning, and tells a real kitanzandimi from an ordinary sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Hears or says /g/ for /gh/, so ghali (expensive) becomes gali (not a Kiswahili word (a spelling error)).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "ghali". Umesikia neno lipi?

misconceptions.cause: /gh/ is made further back in the throat than /g/ and comes into Kiswahili from Arabic; most Kenyan first languages have no /gh/, so the child says and writes g.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "ghali". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "gali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "ghali" ina sauti /gh/. "gali" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (luga where lugha is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a language".

misconceptions.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a language"." with "luga" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "a language" ni "lugha". "luga" lina maana ya "not a Kiswahili word (a spelling error)".
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "lugha" na "luga" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

misconceptions.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""lugha" na "luga" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapana. "lugha" ni a language, na "luga" ni not a Kiswahili word (a spelling error).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.wrong_answer: Meza dawa kwa kufuata maagizo ya daktari.
example.correct_answer: Ghafla Ghalib aligharimika gharama ghali ya dawa ya ghala.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Meza dawa kwa kufuata maagizo ya daktari." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /gh/ na /g/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Breaks the word into syllables at the wrong place, so the target sound is lost (gh-ali read as two wrong parts).

example.question: Neno "ghali" lina silabi zipi?

misconceptions.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "ghali" lina silabi zipi?" with "g-hali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: gha-li.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a formal greeting.

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa barua ya shukrani ya kirafiki?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Mkuu wa Shule" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia salamu ya kirafiki.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia salamu ya kirafiki.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Starts with the closing.

example.question: Barua huanza kwa nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "jina la mwandishi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua huanza kwa anwani na tarehe.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua huanza kwa anwani na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Writes to a friend in the stiff words of an official letter (Mheshimiwa, Kuhusu:, Wako mtiifu).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: The child has seen official letters at school and thinks every letter is written that way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Mheshimiwa Bwana," among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a friendly and an official letter side by side; the child highlights the words that differ.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Starts with the news straight after the greeting, with no asking after the friend (maulizo ya hali).

example.question: Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo? Natumai u buheri wa afya.

misconceptions.cause: The child goes to what he wants to say, as in a text message.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "Nataka kukueleza kuhusu safari yetu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Order the parts on cards: anwani, tarehe, salamu, maulizo ya hali, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina.
misconceptions.feedback: Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the date or writes it in the middle of the letter.

example.question: Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, upande wa kulia juu

misconceptions.cause: The date is not part of what the child wants to say, so he forgets it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "mwishoni, baada ya jina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label a model letter; the child places a date card on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with "Wako mtiifu" and a full name and title, as in an official letter.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: Again the official model is the only one the child has copied.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Wako mtiifu, Bw. Juma Hamisi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three friendly closings and keep them in the exercise book.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thanks in general words without saying what for (Asante kwa kila kitu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi bora katika barua ya shukrani?
example.correct_answer: Asante kwa kunieleza jinsi ya kumeza dawa kwa wakati; sasa nimepona.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks thanking is enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi bora katika barua ya shukrani?" with "Asante kwa kila kitu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Name what was done and what it changed for you.
misconceptions.feedback: Taja wazi unachoshukuru na jinsi kilivyokusaidia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viwakilishi (Theme 2: Matumizi yafaayo ya dawa)
learning_experiences: kuchopoa viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi katika kapu maneno, kadi maneno, chati au katika tarakilishi,
kutaja viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi,
kutambua viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi katika sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikolezea wino,
kujaza nafasi zilizoachwa katika sentensi na vifungu kwa kutumia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi vifaavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la matumizi yafaayo ya dawa,
kumtungia mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake sentensi zinazotumia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi na kuzituma mtandaoni ili wenzake na mwalimu wazitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Kuna tofauti gani kati ya viwakilishi vya sifa na vivumishi vya sifa?
Viwakilishi vya pekee hutumiwa kwa namna gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili kuhusu viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusambazia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi au kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya viwakilishi katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matumizi yafaayo ya dawa na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi katika matini
kutumia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi ifaavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia viwakilishi vya sifa, vya pekee na viulizi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua viwakilishi viulizi na vya sifa
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua viwakilishi viulizi (nani, nini, lipi, kipi, ngapi) vinavyouliza, na vya sifa vinavyochukua nafasi ya nomino na sifa yake (mrefu amefika). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses an interrogative as a statement.

example.question: Ni kiwakilishi kipi kinauliza kuhusu mtu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "yeye" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Nani huuliza kuhusu mtu.
misconceptions.feedback: Nani huuliza kuhusu mtu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes nani and nini.

example.question: Ni kiwakilishi kipi kinauliza kuhusu kitu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "nani" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Nini huuliza kuhusu kitu.
misconceptions.feedback: Nini huuliza kuhusu kitu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not know the sifa pronoun.

example.question: Katika "Mrefu amefika", mrefu ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kivumishi" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Mrefu hapa linasimama badala ya nomino.
misconceptions.feedback: Mrefu hapa linasimama badala ya nomino.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses -enyewe (the pronoun of "self") with the wrong class (kitabu mwenyewe for kitabu chenyewe).

example.question: Jaza: Kitabu ___ kimeanguka.

misconceptions.cause: Mwenyewe is the first form learnt and covers all classes for the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kitabu ___ kimeanguka." with "mwenyewe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Class prefix + -enyewe: mwenyewe (mtu), chenyewe (kitu), lenyewe (jiwe).
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi cha pekee hupatana na ngeli: kitabu chenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hadithi (Theme 3: Dhiki zinazokumba wanyama)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya mighani,
kutafsiri na kueleza sifa za mighani,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uwasilishaji wa mighani,
kushiriki na wenzake kujadili ujumbe na lugha katika mighani aliyosikiliza ikitambwa na wenzake, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali kama vile kinasasauti,
kusikiliza mighani ikisimuliwa katika vifaa vya kidijitali au kutoka kwa mgeni mwalikwa na kubainisha sifa na vipengele vya uwasilishaji vilivyozingatiwa,
kusimulia mighani kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uwasilishaji,
kuwasilishia mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake mighani aliyotafiti katika jamii yake na kujadili ujumbe husika.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unaposimulia mighani unafaa kuzingatia vipengele gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kusimulia mighani na kufafanua sifa za mighani.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochanganua ujumbe na lugha katika mighani.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutafiti kuhusu mighani ya jamii yake akiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapotafiti na kuthamini mighani katika jamii yake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anaposimulia mighani ya jamii yake na kuionea fahari. Pia mwanafunzi anapojifunza kujitolea mhanga, kuitumikia jamii yake kutokana na matendo ya jagina katika mighani.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anaposimulia hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapowazia kuhusu umuhimu wa wanyama.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya mighani katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dhiki zinazokumba wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza dhana ya mighani ili kuipambanua
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uwasilishaji wa mighani
kujadili ujumbe na lugha katika mighani
kusimulia mighani kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uwasilishaji wa mighani
kuchangamkia kushiriki katika uwasilishaji wa mighani katika miktadha mbalimbali ya kijamii

skills.name: Eleza maana, aina na sifa za hadithi
skills.mastery: Explains the maana of hadithi (mighani, visasili) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 tanzu and vipera of fasihi.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two kinds (mighani and visasili) and their purposes.

example.question: "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni hadithi ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both are hadithi; the child has not fixed what each is for and when it is used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni hadithi ya aina gani?" with "visasili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List for each kind: who uses it, when, and why; sort examples.
misconceptions.feedback: "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni mighani: ushujaa na ulinzi wa jamii huheshimiwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls hadithi written literature because it is found in a textbook.

example.question: Hadithi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child meets it on the page in class.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hadithi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi andishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who first made it, and how was it passed on? By mouth, from one generation to the next.
misconceptions.feedback: Hadithi ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Places the hadithi in the wrong occasion (a lullaby at a work party, a work song at a funeral).

example.question: Mighani hutumika lini?
example.correct_answer: kusimulia historia ya shujaa wa jamii na kumsifu

misconceptions.cause: The occasion is not stated in the text, and the child does not link form to use.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mighani hutumika lini?" with "wakati wowote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the occasion; which kind fits it?
misconceptions.feedback: Mighani hutumika kusimulia historia ya shujaa wa jamii na kumsifu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a line of the text as its message instead of the lesson.

example.question: Ujumbe wa "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni upi?
example.wrong_answer: Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni
example.correct_answer: ushujaa na ulinzi wa jamii huheshimiwa.

misconceptions.cause: Copying a line feels like a safe answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni upi?" with "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Close the text; say the lesson in your own words.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 3: Dhiki zinazokumba wanyama)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya tamthilia,
kutafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu sifa za tamthilia,
kuwawasilishia wenzake utafiti wake darasani au kuwasambazia mtandaoni ili wautolee maoni,
kusoma tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu na kutambua sifa zake,
kuwasilishia mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake sifa za tamthilia aliyosoma ili azitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, tamthilia uliyowahi kusoma ilikuwa inahusu nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na kujadili sifa za tamthilia.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kutafiti kuhusu maana na sifa za tamthilia.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kufanya utafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu maana na sifa za tamthilia.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kutafiti kuhusu maana na sifa za tamthilia maktabani na mtandaoni. Pia anapowawasilishia wenzake darasani.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotoa maoni yake kwa upendo kuhusu uwasilishaji wa wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu: mwanafunzi anaposoma tamthilia, mtazamo wake wa ulimwengu unaweza kubadilika na kukua.
Masuala mtambuko mbalimbali kutegemea maudhui katika tamthilia.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha usomaji wa tamthilia katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu usomaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dhiki zinazokumba wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya tamthilia ili kuipambanua
kujadili sifa za tamthilia kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
kuchangamkia usomaji wa tamthilia ili kukuza stadi ya kusoma

skills.name: Eleza maana na sifa za tamthilia
skills.mastery: Explains the utanzu of a tamthilia read in class ("Kilio cha Msitu") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 novela as an utanzu of fasihi andishi.

misconceptions.error: Takes a tamthilia for another kind of text (novela) or gives the features of the other kind.

example.question: Ni sifa ipi ni ya tamthilia?
example.correct_answer: huandikwa kwa mazungumzo ya wahusika ili iigizwe jukwaani

misconceptions.cause: The child has met several kinds of literature and keeps one list of features for all of them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sifa ipi ni ya tamthilia?" with "husimuliwa na msimulizi bila mazungumzo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay a tamthilia and a novela side by side and list what only the tamthilia has.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamthilia huandikwa kwa mazungumzo ili iigizwe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls a tamthilia oral literature (fasihi simulizi) because it can be read aloud or acted.

example.question: Tamthilia ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: Plays are acted and poems are recited, so the child thinks of them as spoken.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tamthilia ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi simulizi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: was it first composed in writing by a known author? Then it is fasihi andishi, even when performed.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamthilia ni fasihi andishi: imeandikwa na mwandishi anayejulikana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one feature only (length, or rhyme) as the whole meaning of a tamthilia.

example.question: Eleza maana ya tamthilia.
example.correct_answer: ni kazi ya fasihi andishi iliyoandikwa kwa mazungumzo ili iigizwe jukwaani

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the most visible feature.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Eleza maana ya tamthilia." with "ni mchezo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Build the definition from three parts: what kind of text, its form, its purpose.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana kamili ya tamthilia hutaja aina yake, muundo wake na lengo lake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the narrator or a character for the author of the tamthilia.

example.question: Ni nani mwandishi wa "Kilio cha Msitu"?

misconceptions.cause: The narrator speaks as "I" and the child takes that voice for the writer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nani mwandishi wa "Kilio cha Msitu"?" with "Bi. Zuhura" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the author's name on the cover; the narrator and characters are inside the story.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwandishi ni mtunzi; msimulizi na wahusika ni sehemu ya kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 3: Dhiki zinazokumba wanyama)
learning_experiences: kutambua wazo moja kuu la simulizi kwenye matini andishi na za kidijitali au katika kielelezo cha insha za kubuni,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia wazo moja kuu,
kuliendeleza wazo moja kuu katika kila aya kupitia kwa wahusika katika simulizi,
kuandika kwenye tarakilishi, insha ya kubuni kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia wazo moja kuu na kuwasambazia wenzake kwenye mtandao ili waitolee maoni,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika na kuwataka kutambua wazo moja kuu.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vipengele vipi vya kimsingi utakavyozingatia unapoandika insha ya kubuni?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha na kuisambaza mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kwa kuzingatia wazo moja kuu.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya kubuni kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dhiki zinazokumba wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kubaini wazo moja kuu la insha ya masimulizi atakayoandika
kuandika insha ya masimulizi inayoendeleza wazo moja kuu katika kila aya
kufurahia kuandika insha za masimulizi katika maisha ya kila siku akizingatia ujumbe uliotegemezwa kwenye wazo moja kuu

skills.name: Bainisha wazo kuu na uandike insha ya masimulizi inayoliendeleza
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 built one idea per paragraph in a masimulizi.

misconceptions.error: Puts several ideas in one paragraph, or one idea across many tiny paragraphs, so no idea is built up.

example.question: Aya nzuri ya insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji" ina nini?
example.correct_answer: wazo moja kuu linalokuzwa kwa maelezo na mifano

misconceptions.cause: Paragraphs are made where the child pauses, not where an idea ends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Aya nzuri ya insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji" ina nini?" with "mawazo mengi tofauti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Topic sentence first; then two or three sentences that develop only it; a link to the next paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila aya ikuze wazo moja kuu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Plans with points (vidokezo) that do not belong to the title, or writes the insha without using the points planned.

example.question: Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?

misconceptions.cause: The child lists whatever comes to mind and does not check each point against the title.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?" with "Bei ya sukari imepanda dukani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write the title at the top of the plan; tick each point only if it helps to tell that story.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila kidokezo kinapaswa kusaidia kusimulia kisa cha anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?
example.wrong_answer: walinzi walimwongoza mtoni, wanakijiji waliogopa, alifika kijijini, tembo alikosa maji
example.correct_answer: tembo alikosa maji, alifika kijijini, wanakijiji waliogopa, walinzi walimwongoza mtoni

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?" with "walinzi walimwongoza mtoni, wanakijiji waliogopa, alifika kijijini, tembo alikosa maji" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza mengi kuhusu jambo hili.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Tembo Aliyekosa Maji"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viwakilishi (Theme 3: Dhiki zinazokumba wanyama)
learning_experiences: kuchopoa viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi katika kapu maneno, orodha ya maneno, sentensi, vifungu au katika tarakilishi,
kutaja viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi,
kutambua viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi, vifungu kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikolezea wino,
kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la dhiki zinazokumba wanyama,
kumsomea mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake sentensi zinazotumia viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi ili azitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapotumia viwakilishi vimilikishi?
Je, viwakilishi visisitizi vina muhimu gani katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotajia wenzake viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji, pia anapojitolea kufanya kazimradi.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi au kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya viwakilishi katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dhiki zinazokumba wanyama na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Integrated Science na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi katika matini
kutumia viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi katika sentensi na vifungu

skills.name: Tambua viwakilishi vimilikishi na visisitizi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kimilikishi (changu, chake, chetu, vyao) kinachoonyesha umiliki na kisisitizi (mwenyewe, wenyewe) kinachosisitiza mtu au kitu. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Mixes kimilikishi and kisisitizi.

example.question: Ni kiwakilishi kimilikishi kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mwenyewe" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Changu ni kimilikishi.
misconceptions.feedback: Changu ni kimilikishi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes kisisitizi and kimilikishi.

example.question: Ni kiwakilishi kisisitizi kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "changu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Mwenyewe ni kisisitizi.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwenyewe ni kisisitizi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Wrong agreement of possessive.

example.question: Kamilisha: kitabu ___ (changu/wangu)

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "wangu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kitabu hupatana na changu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu hupatana na changu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Leaves the possessive pronoun without its class prefix when it stands alone (Angu kimepotea for Changu kimepotea).

example.question: Jaza (kitabu, mimi): ___ kimepotea.

misconceptions.cause: Without the noun in front, the child forgets the prefix.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza (kitabu, mimi): ___ kimepotea." with "Angu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the noun silently first, then drop it but keep its prefix: (kitabu) changu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kimilikishi kinachosimama peke yake huhifadhi kiambishi: Changu kimepotea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hadithi (Theme 4: Matumizi bora ya maliasili)
learning_experiences: kutafiti na kueleza maana ya visasili,
kufanya utafiti maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu sifa za visasili,
kuwawasilishia wenzake matokeo ya utafiti wake wa sifa za visasili ili wazijadili,
kujadili vipengele vya kimsingi katika uwasilishaji wa visasili (k.v. ujumbe, wahusika na mbinu za lugha),
kusikiliza visasili katika vifaa vya kidijitali au kutoka kwa mgeni mwalikwa na kubainisha vipengele vya kimsingi vya uwasilishaji wa visasili,
kusimulia visasili kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya kimsingi vya visasili,
kujadili na mzazi au mlezi kuhusu visasili katika jamii yake,
kusimulia visasili akiwa na mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake akizingatia vipengele vya kimsingi vya uwasilishaji.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, uwasilishaji wa hadithi ya visasili huzingatia vipengele gani?
Visasili vina sifa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kusimulia visasili kwenye kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusikiliza visasili mbalimbali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposimulia visasili.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kusimulia visasili na mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika majadiliano ya kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha visasili kuhusu suala la maliasili katika mazingira yake.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha visasili kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwazia kuhusu matumizi ya maliasili.
Umaskini: mwanafunzi anapowazia jinsi matumizi yafaayo ya maliasili yanawezesha kupunguza umaskini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya visasili katika somo la Kiswahili na yale amejifunza kuhusu dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matumizi bora ya maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Agriculture na Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza dhana ya visasili ili kuibanisha
kujadili vipengele vya kimsingi katika uwasilishaji wa visasili
kuwasilisha visasili kwa kuzingatia uwasilishaji ufaao
kufurahia uchambuzi na uwasilishaji wa visasili ili kujenga umahiri katika fasihi simulizi

skills.name: Wasilisha hadithi kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji
skills.mastery: Explains the uwasilishaji of hadithi (visasili, mighani) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 3 met mighani; visasili are the next kind.

misconceptions.error: Starts or ends without the opening or closing formula (Paukwa!).

example.question: Msimulizi anaanzaje?
example.wrong_answer: anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa

misconceptions.cause: Telling has been practised as reading a text aloud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Msimulizi anaanzaje?" with "anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise the formula with the class answering.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa fomula: "Paukwa!" - "Pakawa!"
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Presents in one flat voice, with no change for characters or feelings.

example.question: Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?
example.correct_answer: ibadilike kulingana na mhusika na hisia

misconceptions.cause: The child is shy and keeps the voice safe.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unapowasilisha, sauti yako iweje?" with "moja tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Give each character a voice; rehearse one line in each.
misconceptions.feedback: Badilisha sauti kulingana na mhusika na hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses no gestures, or gestures that do not match the words.

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?

misconceptions.cause: The body is forgotten under the stress of remembering words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?" with "kushika kichwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mirror pairs: one says, one shows; swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara ziendane na maneno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Presents to the floor or the teacher only, with no eye contact and no call for responses.

example.question: Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?

misconceptions.cause: Reciting for marks is done to the teacher.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unawasilisha mbele ya darasa. Unawaangalia nani?" with "chini au mwalimu peke yake" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Divide the room into three; look at each part in turn.
misconceptions.feedback: Iangalie na uishirikishe hadhira yote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 4: Matumizi bora ya maliasili)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,
kutazama na kusikiliza video inayoonyesha usomaji fasaha wa makala (k.v. hotuba, habari,),
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 100 kwa dakika),
kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo,
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kusoma kwa ufasaha kuna umuhimu gani?
Unaposoma kifungu ni mambo yapi unayozingatia ili kufanikisha usomaji kwa ufasaha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kujadiliana kuhusu vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya usomaji.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji wanapojadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika mjadala wakati wa shughuli ya ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake kifungu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa hasa kuhusu suala la maliasili katika mazingira yake.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwazia kuhusu matumizi ya maliasili.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kusoma kwa ufasaha katika somo la Kiswahili na usomaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matumizi bora ya maliasili na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Agriculture na Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kuvibainisha
kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo
kuchangamkia kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya usomaji

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Wakulima walichimba mitaro ili kuhifadhi maji ya mvua."?
example.wrong_answer: Wakulima ... walichimba ... mitaro ... ili ... kuhifadhi ... maji ... ya ... mvua.
example.correct_answer: Wakulima walichimba mitaro ili kuhifadhi maji ya mvua.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Wakulima walichimba mitaro ili kuhifadhi maji ya mvua."?" with "Wakulima ... walichimba ... mitaro ... ili ... kuhifadhi ... maji ... ya ... mvua." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, tutaacha misitu yetu iangamie?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, tutaacha misitu yetu iangamie?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Lo, mto umerudi kutiririka!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Lo, mto umerudi kutiririka!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (rasilimali read as lasilimali).

example.question: Neno "rasilimali" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "rasilimali" linatamkwa vipi?" with "lasilimali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "rasilimali" kama lilivyoandikwa; "lasilimali" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 4: Matumizi bora ya maliasili)
learning_experiences: kutambua mbinu za lugha (k.v. tashbihi, sitiari, nahau,) katika vielelezo vya insha ya masimulizi,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili umuhimu wa lugha ya kiubunifu katika vielelezo vya insha za masimulizi,
kutafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu umuhimu wa mbinu za lugha katika insha ya masimulizi,
kuwasilisha utafiti wake darasani ili kujadiliana na wenzake,
kujadili na wenzake wahusika na mandhari katika vielelezo vya insha za masimulizi kutoka kwenye maandishi au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akitumia lugha ya kiubunifu na kuwabainisha wahusika na mandhari akizingatia suala lengwa,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini,
kumsomea mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi ili aitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vipengele vipi vya kimsingi utakavyozingatia unapoandika insha ya masimulizi?
Mbinu za lugha zina umuhimu gani katika uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya insha ya masimulizi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutafiti kuhusu mbinu za lugha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapodhamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala la maliasili katika mazingira yake.

outcomes.text: kutambua mbinu za lugha katika insha ya masimulizi
kujadili umuhimu wa mbinu za lugha katika insha za masimulizi
kujadili wahusika na mandhari katika insha za masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia mbinu za lugha, wahusika wanaobainika na mandhari ifaavyo
kufurahia kuandika insha ya masimulizi akizingatia lugha, wahusika na mandhari ifaavyo ili kukuza ubunifu

skills.name: Andika insha ya masimulizi kwa mbinu za lugha, wahusika na mandhari
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 3 built a story on one main idea.
Grade 7 creative language, characters and setting.

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Siku Mto Ulipofurika"?
example.correct_answer: Maji yalinguruma kama simba mwenye njaa yakimeza mashamba yote.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Siku Mto Ulipofurika"?" with "Maji yalikuwa mengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the characters no names, no features and no words of their own, so the reader cannot see them.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Siku Mto Ulipofurika"?
example.correct_answer: Mzee Juma, mwenye ndevu nyeupe na fimbo ya mpingo, alisimama mlangoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the events, not the people in them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamjenga mhusika vizuri katika insha "Siku Mto Ulipofurika"?" with "Mtu mmoja alikuja." among the options.
misconceptions.help: For each character: a name, one look, one trait shown by an action.
misconceptions.feedback: Wape wahusika majina, sura na tabia zinazoonekana kwa matendo yao.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives no setting (time and place) or one that does not fit the events.

example.question: Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Siku Mto Ulipofurika"?
example.correct_answer: Ilikuwa jioni ya Ijumaa katika soko la Gikomba, watu wakiwa wamesongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child starts with the action.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mwanzo upi unaonyesha mandhari ya insha "Siku Mto Ulipofurika"?" with "Kisa hiki kilitokea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Answer lini? wapi? hali gani? in the first paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Onyesha mandhari: lini, wapi na hali gani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: States feelings with one word (nilihuzunika) and never shows them, so the reader feels nothing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inamgusa msomaji zaidi?
example.correct_answer: Machozi yalinitiririka nilipoona kibanda chetu kikiteketea.

misconceptions.cause: Showing a feeling needs words for the body and the scene.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inamgusa msomaji zaidi?" with "Nilihuzunika." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Turn "nilihuzunika" into what the body did and what was seen.
misconceptions.feedback: Onyesha hisia kwa vitendo na picha, si kwa neno moja tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 4: Matumizi bora ya maliasili)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu,
kusoma kifungu na kutambua hali iliyotumiwa,
kuchagua vitenzi vinavyoashiria hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika chati, sentensi, vifungu, na tarakilishi,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu ipasavyo,

kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi daftarini mwake au katika kifaa cha kidijitali kwa kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la matumizi bora ya maliasili,
kuwasomea wenzake au kuwasambazia mtandaoni kazi yake ili waitolee maoni,
kumwasilishia mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake sentensi alizotunga katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu ili amtolee maoni.

skills.name: Tambua hali ya mazoea na hali timilifu
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua hali ya mazoea inayotumia hu- (huenda sokoni kila siku) na hali timilifu inayotumia -me- (amefika) kuonyesha tendo lililokamilika. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.error: Thinks hu- shows a finished act.

example.question: Katika "Huenda sokoni kila siku", hali ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "timilifu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hu- huonyesha mazoea.
misconceptions.feedback: Hu- huonyesha mazoea.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks -me- shows habit.

example.question: Katika "Amefika", hali ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ya mazoea" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: -me- huonyesha tendo lililokamilika.
misconceptions.feedback: -me- huonyesha tendo lililokamilika.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks -li- is timilifu.

example.question: Katika "Alifika", ni hali gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "timilifu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: -li- ni wakati uliopita rahisi.
misconceptions.feedback: -li- ni wakati uliopita rahisi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses hu- with a time word of one moment (Jana huenda shuleni).

example.question: Jaza: Kila Jumamosi tu___ (fua) nguo.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the tense of the time word he sees, not the meaning of "kila".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kila Jumamosi tu___ (fua) nguo." with "tulifua" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Kila siku, kila Jumamosi, mara nyingi point to a habit: hu-.
misconceptions.feedback: Jambo la mazoea hutumia hu-: kila Jumamosi hufua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza Maagizo (Theme 5: Majukumu ya kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya maagizo ili kuipambanua,
kubainisha maagizo miongoni mwa kauli zilizoandikwa katika kadi, kapu maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutambua maagizo kutoka kwenye kitabu, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za kimsingi za maagizo yafaayo,
kutafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu sifa za maagizo na kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani ili wazitathmini,
kuigiza utoaji na uitikiaji wa maagizo mbalimbali kwa uwazi,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu aina mbalimbali za maagizo kulingana na miktadha ya jamii zao,
kusikiliza maagizo ya aina mbalimbali yanayotolewa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kutaja maagizo yaliyomo,

skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelekezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes instructions with their purpose, the materials, the steps in order as commands, and safety warnings; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Starts the steps without saying what is needed (vifaa) or what the instructions are for.

example.question: Maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupika Chakula cha Familia Pamoja" huanza na nini?
example.wrong_answer: hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: lengo la maelekezo na vifaa vinavyohitajika

misconceptions.cause: The child goes straight to doing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupika Chakula cha Familia Pamoja" huanza na nini?" with "hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: lengo, vifaa, hatua, tahadhari.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa lengo na vifaa vinavyohitajika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells what he did in the past (Nilichukua..., nilikoroga...) instead of giving instructions (Chukua..., koroga...).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo?

misconceptions.cause: The child turns instructions into a story of his own day.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo?" with "Nilichukua sufuria nikaweka maji." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the verbs; change each to the command or -e form (chukua, weka; uchukue).
misconceptions.feedback: Maelekezo hutumia amri au hali ya kuagiza: chukua, weka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps in an order that cannot work, with no signal words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika "Jinsi ya Kupika Chakula cha Familia Pamoja"?
example.wrong_answer: pakua na mle pamoja, andaa mboga na nafaka, osha vyombo na mikono, gawanya kazi kwa wote
example.correct_answer: gawanya kazi kwa wote, osha vyombo na mikono, andaa mboga na nafaka, pakua na mle pamoja

misconceptions.cause: The child lists steps as he remembers them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika "Jinsi ya Kupika Chakula cha Familia Pamoja"?" with "pakua na mle pamoja, andaa mboga na nafaka, osha vyombo na mikono, gawanya kazi kwa wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; add kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa hatua na utumie maneno ya mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out safety warnings where the task needs them.

example.question: Ni kipi kinakosekana katika maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupika Chakula cha Familia Pamoja"?

misconceptions.cause: Warnings are not part of the steps, so they are forgotten.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi kinakosekana katika maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupika Chakula cha Familia Pamoja"?" with "anwani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask at each step: what could go wrong? Write a tahadhari.
misconceptions.feedback: Ongeza tahadhari pale panapohitajika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 5: Majukumu ya kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu,
kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita hali timilifu (li, me) na wakati ujao hali timilifu (ta, me),
kutenga vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu kutoka kwenye chati au mti maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la majukumu ya kijinsia,
kuandika kifungu kifupi kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili wakibadilishe katika nyakati na hali lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini ni muhimu kujifunza nyakati na hali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kutoa mchango wake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika kifungu kifupi na kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na vifungu sahihi kuhusu nyakati na hali lengwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nyakati na hali na kuzitungia sentensi sahihi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizotunga kwa kutumia nyakati na hali lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya kijinsia: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na ujao hali timilifu katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majukumu ya kijinsia na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.
