skills.name: Tambua uliopita timilifu na ujao timilifu
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua uliopita timilifu (alikuwa amefika) na ujao timilifu (atakuwa amefika), na hutofautisha kila mmoja na wakati rahisi. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 7 continuous with kuwa: the same two-verb pattern.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two perfect tenses.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi iko katika uliopita timilifu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Atakuwa amefika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Alikuwa amefika ni uliopita timilifu.
misconceptions.feedback: Alikuwa amefika ni uliopita timilifu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two perfect tenses.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi iko katika ujao timilifu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Alikuwa amefika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Atakuwa amefika ni ujao timilifu.
misconceptions.feedback: Atakuwa amefika ni ujao timilifu.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Takes the simple tense as perfect.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni timilifu?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Alifika jana" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Timilifu ina ame- baada ya alikuwa.
misconceptions.feedback: Timilifu ina ame- baada ya alikuwa.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts the time marker on both verbs (alikuwa alimefika) instead of on kuwa only.

example.question: Jaza: Tulipofika, mgeni ___ (fika) tayari.

misconceptions.cause: The child marks the past twice to be sure.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Tulipofika, mgeni ___ (fika) tayari." with "alikuwa alifika" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time on kuwa (-li-, -ta-), completion on the main verb (-me-).
misconceptions.feedback: Wakati hukaa kwenye "kuwa", na -me- kwenye kitenzi kikuu: alikuwa amefika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri (Theme 6: Usalama nyumbani)
learning_experiences: kueleza masuala yanayozungumziwa katika matini aliyosikiliza kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika vifaa vya kidijitali,
kusikiliza matini katika vifaa vya kidijitali, kutoka kwa mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa na kueleza uhusiano wa ujumbe wa matini hiyo na maisha ya kila siku,
kujadili na wenzake mafunzo yanayotokana na ujumbe wa matini,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusikiliza na kuchanganua habari katika matini za aina mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni ujumbe gani uliosikiliza katika matini ambao unafanana na mambo katika jamii yako?
Unajifunza nini kutokana na ujumbe katika matini ulizosikiliza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kutoa hoja na anapoeleza kikamilifu masuala yanayozungumziwa katika habari aliyosikiliza.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza habari.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapohusisha habari inayozungumziwa katika matini aliyosikiliza na maisha ya kila siku katika kutatua matatizo ya jamii.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwaelezea wenzake masuala yanayozungumziwa katika matini aliyosikiliza.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojadili na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu habari katika matini aliyosikiliza.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na kutunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya usalama: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza matini kuhusu suala lengwa.

Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusikiliza kwa kufasiri katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

skills.name: Tambua ujumbe na mafunzo katika matini ya kusikiliza
skills.mastery: Mtoto hukumbuka alichosikia na huchagua jibu linalolingana na matini yote, wala hachagui jambo dogo, kinyume au jambo lisilomo kwenye matini. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.
question_forms: chagua jibu katika matini ya pili

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 message of a listening text.

misconceptions.error: Picks one small detail instead of the answer asked for.

example.question: Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "jibu lisilopatana na matini" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Jibu lazima lijibu swali lote, si jambo moja dogo.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu lazima lijibu swali lote, si jambo moja dogo.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.

example.question: Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "jibu lisilopatana na matini" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Jibu lazima lipatikane kwenye matini, si kuongezwa kutoka nje.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu lazima lipatikane kwenye matini, si kuongezwa kutoka nje.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia (Theme 6: Usalama nyumbani)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya maudhui katika fasihi,
kutambua maudhui mbalimbali katika tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili na wenzake maudhui ya tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu maudhui,
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu maudhui katika tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kueleza maana ya dhamira katika fasihi,
kutambua dhamira ya tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili na wenzake dhamira katika tamthilia,
kuandika maelezo mafupi kuhusu dhamira ya tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake uchambuzi wake kuhusu maudhui na dhamira ili wautolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani muhimu yaliyo katika tamthilia ulizosoma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kujadili dhamira na maudhui katika tamthilia.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowawasilishia wenzake ufupisho wa dhamira na maudhui ili waujadili na kutolea maoni.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochanganua maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia na kuwasilishia wenzake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake wanapotambua na kujadili dhamira na maudhui katika tamthilia.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotoa maoni kuhusu uwasilishaji wa wengine ili kuwarekebisha na kuwahimiza.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotagusana na wengine ili kutambua na kujadili dhamira na maudhui katika tamthilia.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai: mwanafunzi anaposoma na kuchambua maudhui mbalimbali katika tamthilia.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi ili kuipambanua
kutambua maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia

skills.name: Jadili maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia
skills.mastery: Explains the maudhui of a tamthilia read in class ("Kilio cha Msitu") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: What a tamthilia is comes first.
Grade 7 maudhui and dhamira in a novela.

misconceptions.error: Swaps maudhui (the issues the work is about) and dhamira (what the author aims to teach).

example.question: Katika "Kilio cha Msitu", "kuhimiza jamii kutunza msitu na kupinga ufisadi" ni maudhui au dhamira?

misconceptions.cause: The two words are taught together and both answer "what is it about?"
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika "Kilio cha Msitu", "kuhimiza jamii kutunza msitu na kupinga ufisadi" ni maudhui au dhamira?" with "maudhui" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Maudhui: the issues raised (ufisadi, elimu). Dhamira: the author's aim (kuonya, kuhimiza). Sort sentences into the two.
misconceptions.feedback: Maudhui ni masuala yanayoshughulikiwa; dhamira ni lengo la mwandishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title or the setting of the work as its maudhui.

example.question: Ni ipi ni maudhui katika "Kilio cha Msitu"?

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only phrase about the whole work the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni maudhui katika "Kilio cha Msitu"?" with "Kilio cha Msitu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what issue the characters face and argue about; that is the maudhui.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja kazi; maudhui ni masuala yanayoshughulikiwa ndani yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one event of the story as its maudhui.

example.question: Maudhui ya "Kilio cha Msitu" ni yapi?

misconceptions.cause: The event is memorable; the child has not moved from what happened to what it is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maudhui ya "Kilio cha Msitu" ni yapi?" with "Zuhura anazuia malori ya mbao" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: this event shows which issue? Write the issue in one or two words.
misconceptions.feedback: Tukio huonyesha maudhui; si maudhui lenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: States a lesson from his own life or religion that the work does not raise.

example.question: Kwa mujibu wa "Kilio cha Msitu", mwandishi analenga nini?
example.wrong_answer: kutuhimiza tuende kanisani au msikitini kila wiki
example.correct_answer: kuhimiza jamii kutunza msitu na kupinga ufisadi

misconceptions.cause: The question sounds like a moral question and the child gives a moral he knows.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kwa mujibu wa "Kilio cha Msitu", mwandishi analenga nini?" with "kutuhimiza tuende kanisani au msikitini kila wiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask for the part of the text that shows the aim.
misconceptions.feedback: Dhamira lazima itokane na kazi yenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 6: Usalama nyumbani)

kueleza vipengele vilivyozingatiwa katika uandishi wa insha ya mdokezo aliyosoma,
kuandika insha ya mdokezo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uandishi wa insha za mdokezo,
kuwasilisha insha yake darasani ili wenzake waitolee maoni,
kuwasilishia mzazi au mlezi insha aliyoiandika ili aitolee maoni.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.

skills.name: Andika insha ya mdokezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya mdokezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a story that starts or ends with the exact words given and leads to them; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: A creative story written in Theme 4.
Grade 7 built one idea per paragraph in a masimulizi.

misconceptions.error: Changes the words he was given to start or end with.

example.question: Umepewa: "Nilipofungua mlango, moshi mzito ulinikaribisha." kama mwanzo. Ufanye nini?
example.wrong_answer: anza kwa sentensi yako inayofanana nayo
example.correct_answer: anza kwa maneno hayo hasa bila kuyabadilisha

misconceptions.cause: The child copies the idea, not the exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Umepewa: "Nilipofungua mlango, moshi mzito ulinikaribisha." kama mwanzo. Ufanye nini?" with "anza kwa sentensi yako inayofanana nayo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Copy the given words first, then continue.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia maneno uliyopewa kama yalivyo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the given ending in the middle of the insha, or the given opening at the end.

example.question: Insha ya mdokezo wa kumalizia: maneno uliyopewa yawekwe wapi?

misconceptions.cause: The two kinds of mdokezo are not told apart.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha ya mdokezo wa kumalizia: maneno uliyopewa yawekwe wapi?" with "katikati ya insha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label the two kinds: mdokezo wa kuanzia and wa kumalizia.
misconceptions.feedback: Mdokezo wa kumalizia huwekwa mwishoni.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes a story that does not lead to the given ending.

example.question: Insha inaishia: "Nilipofungua mlango, moshi mzito ulinikaribisha." Kisa kiwe vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kisa chochote kisha kuweka maneno hayo mwishoni
example.correct_answer: kisa ambacho matukio yake yanaelekea kwenye maneno hayo

misconceptions.cause: The ending is added like a sticker.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha inaishia: "Nilipofungua mlango, moshi mzito ulinikaribisha." Kisa kiwe vipi?" with "kisa chochote kisha kuweka maneno hayo mwishoni" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan backwards: what must happen for this ending to make sense?
misconceptions.feedback: Matukio ya insha yaelekee mdokezo uliotolewa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes tenses between the given words and his own story.

example.question: Mdokezo uko katika wakati uliopita. Insha yako iweje?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes in the tense he likes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mdokezo uko katika wakati uliopita. Insha yako iweje?" with "katika wakati uliopo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the tense of the given words; keep it.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata wakati wa mdokezo uliopewa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vivumishi (Theme 6: Usalama nyumbani)
learning_experiences: kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria kwenye chati, kadi maneno au kapu maneno,
kutenga vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikolezea wino katika matini za kidijitali,
kumtajia mwenzake vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria katika mazingira ya shuleni na ya nyumbani,
kutafiti mtandaoni kuhusu vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la usalama nyumbani,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kuhusu vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria alivyotafiti mtandaoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kuna tofauti gani kati ya vivumishi vya sifa na vivumishi viashiria?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapochangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutafiti kuhusu vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria na kuzitungia sentensi na vifungu sahihi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafiti mtandaoni kuhusu vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya usalama: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usalama nyumbani na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi katika matini
kutumia vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria/vionyeshi ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vivumishi vya sifa na viashiria katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua vivumishi vya sifa na vya kuashiria
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kivumishi cha sifa (mzuri, refu) kinachoeleza nomino na kivumishi cha kuashiria (huyu, huo, ile) kinachoonyesha nomino. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.error: Mixes sifa and kuashiria.

example.question: Ni kivumishi cha sifa kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "huyu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Mzuri ni kivumishi cha sifa.
misconceptions.feedback: Mzuri ni kivumishi cha sifa.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes kuashiria and sifa.

example.question: Ni kivumishi cha kuashiria kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mzuri" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Huyu ni kivumishi cha kuashiria.
misconceptions.feedback: Huyu ni kivumishi cha kuashiria.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts the adjective before the noun.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imepangwa sawa?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Mzuri mtoto" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kivumishi hufuata nomino.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi hufuata nomino.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts a class prefix on a loan adjective that never takes one (msafi is right, but mghali, kighali for ghali; mlaini for laini).

example.question: Jaza: Dawa hii ni ___ (ghali).

misconceptions.cause: The child applies the agreement rule to every adjective, including Arabic and other loans that do not change.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Dawa hii ni ___ (ghali)." with "nghali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of adjectives that never change (ghali, safi in some uses, laini, hodari, imara).
misconceptions.feedback: Baadhi ya vivumishi havibadiliki: dawa ghali, kitabu ghali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Usikilizaji Husishi (Theme 7: Kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya usikilizaji husishi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika usikilizaji husishi,
kusikiliza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali akizingatia na kutambua vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi vilivyozingatiwa,
kumsikiliza mwenzake, mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa akisema kauli au akisoma vifungu vifupi kuhusu suala lengwa na kufasiri hisia zake,
kuigiza kikao cha utoaji nasaha akishirikiana na wenzake huku akizingatia vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi,
kushiriki mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa na mzazi, mlezi au mwenzake huku akizingatia vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi.
key_inquiry_questions: Unaposhiriki katika usikilizaji husishi, utazingatia nini ili kufanikisha usikilizaji?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadili kuhusu vipengele vya kuzingatia katika usikilizaji husishi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofasiri hisia za msemaji.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa na mzazi au mlezi wake na kujifunza zaidi vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Pia mwanafunzi anapoheshimu zamu ya wenzake katika mazungumzo.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowasikiliza wasemaji kwa makini na kujihusisha na hisia zao.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika mazungumzo.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo akizingatia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha usikilizaji husishi katika somo la Kiswahili na usikilizaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya usikilizaji husishi ili kuubainisha
kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika usikilizaji husishi
kufanya mazungumzo yanayozingatia vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi
kuchangamkia kushiriki katika usikilizaji husishi ili kujenga uhusiano mwema na wengine

skills.name: Tumia usikilizaji husishi katika mazungumzo
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (husishi), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on kumsaidia mwanafunzi mwenye ulemavu, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 1 listened and replied in an interview.

misconceptions.error: Does not show he has understood (no paraphrase or question) and moves to his own story.

example.question: Mwenzako anakueleza tatizo lake. Ni jibu lipi la usikilizaji husishi?
example.wrong_answer: Hilo si kitu, mimi nilikuwa na tatizo kubwa zaidi...
example.correct_answer: Kwa hiyo unasema unahisi upweke shuleni? Pole sana.

misconceptions.cause: The child wants to share his own story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako anakueleza tatizo lake. Ni jibu lipi la usikilizaji husishi?" with "Hilo si kitu, mimi nilikuwa na tatizo kubwa zaidi..." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise "Kwa hiyo unasema..." before any reply.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudia kwa maneno yako ulichosikia, kisha uliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Judges or advises at once instead of listening first.

example.question: Rafiki ana huzuni. Unaanza kwa?

misconceptions.cause: Advice feels like help.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki ana huzuni. Unaanza kwa?" with "Hupaswi kuhuzunika!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Listen, reflect, then ask before advising.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza kwanza bila kuhukumu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Interrupts the speaker before he finishes.

example.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child fears losing his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?" with "mkatize ili usisahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Note the idea on paper; wait for the pause.
misconceptions.feedback: Msikilize mzungumzaji hadi amalize.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: (Theme 7: Kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya ufupisho akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadili vipengele vya ufupisho wa kifungu akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutambua kwenye matini andishi au ya kidijitali habari za kimsingi katika makala na kuzieleza kwa usahihi kwa kuzingatia mtazamo wa matini katika matini ya kufupishwa,
kueleza kwa maneno yake habari muhimu katika kifungu alichosoma,
kufupisha kifungu alichosoma kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao wa habari sahihi kutokana na matini akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuwawasilishia wenzake kazi yake ili waitolee maoni,
kumweleza mzazi au mlezi namna ya kufupisha kifungu kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao wa habari sahihi kutokana na matini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapofupisha kifungu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadiliana habari kuu za aya kwenye kifungu alichosoma.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoandaa ufupisho na kuwawasilishia wenzake ili wautolee maoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika ufupisho kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu mtandaoni na kudondoa hoja muhimu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili vipengele vya ufupisho wa kifungu.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Pia, anapojitolea kuiandaa kazi yake ili kuwawasilishia wenzake.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili maneno na hoja muhimu katika kifungu.
sub_strands.pcis:
Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Uongozi na utawala mwema: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa hasa kuhusu maongozi yanayojali watu wote.

Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya ufupisho ili kuupambanua

skills.name: Fupisha kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya ufupisho
skills.mastery: Explains what a summary is, picks the main points of a passage on the theme (not the examples), and writes them in his own words, in order, within the word limit and without his own opinion; written summaries are marked by the teacher, and in the app the child picks the right point in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Copies whole sentences from the passage into the summary.

example.question: Ufupisho mzuri huandikwa vipi?
example.correct_answer: kwa maneno yako mwenyewe bila kupoteza maana

misconceptions.cause: Copying feels safe; the child fears changing the meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ufupisho mzuri huandikwa vipi?" with "kunakili sentensi muhimu kutoka kifungu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read, close the passage, write the point; then check it against the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Fupisha kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Keeps the examples and illustrations in the summary.

example.question: Ni lipi liingie katika ufupisho?
example.wrong_answer: Kwa mfano, shule ya Kilimani ilijenga njia mbili mwaka 2025.
example.correct_answer: Shule zinapaswa kujenga njia za kupitisha viti vya magurudumu.

misconceptions.cause: Examples are concrete and easy to keep.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi liingie katika ufupisho?" with "Kwa mfano, shule ya Kilimani ilijenga njia mbili mwaka 2025." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cross out every "kwa mfano" and every number that only illustrates.
misconceptions.feedback: Ufupisho hubeba hoja kuu tu, si mifano.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Adds his own opinion or advice that the passage does not give.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi isiingie katika ufupisho?
example.wrong_answer: Shule zinapaswa kujenga njia za kupitisha viti vya magurudumu.
example.correct_answer: Mimi nadhani serikali inapaswa kufanya zaidi.

misconceptions.cause: The child wants to show he has views on the topic.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi isiingie katika ufupisho?" with "Shule zinapaswa kujenga njia za kupitisha viti vya magurudumu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask of every sentence: did the writer say this?
misconceptions.feedback: Usiongeze maoni yako katika ufupisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Goes over the word limit (60 words) or writes in notes with no sentences.

example.question: Umeambiwa ufupishe kwa maneno 60. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child is afraid of leaving out a point.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Umeambiwa ufupishe kwa maneno 60. Ufanye nini?" with "andika zaidi ili usiache kitu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Count words after the first draft; join points that repeat.
misconceptions.feedback: Zingatia idadi ya maneno: 60.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 7: Kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum)
learning_experiences: kutambua tamathali mbalimbali za lugha katika vielelezo vya insha za maelezo (k.v. tashbihi, sitiari, uhaishaji na tanakali sauti),
kutambua jinsi tamathali za lugha katika kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo zinavyochangia kujenga picha dhahiri ya kinachoelezewa,
kupigia mstari tamathali mbalimbali zilizotumiwa kwenye kifungu na kutoa maelezo katika kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia tamathali mbalimbali za lugha ili kujenga picha dhahiri katika insha ya maelezo,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unatumia lugha ya aina gani wakati unapotaka kumweleza mtu kitu ili aweze kupata picha kamili?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuandika insha ya maelezo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika insha inayosawiri picha halisi ya kitu anachoelezea.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waikosoe pamoja.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Haki na majuku ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.
Uongozi na utawala mwema: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa hasa kuhusu maongozi yanayojali watu wote.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya maelezo katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua tamathali mbalimbali za lugha katika insha ya maelezo
kueleza jinsi tamathali mbalimbali za lugha zinavyochangia kujenga picha dhahiri katika insha ya maelezo
kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia tamathali mbalimbali za lugha ili kujenga picha dhahiri
kufurahia kuandika insha za maelezo akitumia tamathali mbalimbali za lugha ili kujenga picha dhahiri

skills.name: Tumia tamathali za lugha kujenga picha dhahiri katika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 exact vocabulary in a maelezo.

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum"?
example.correct_answer: Bustani ya kituo ilikuwa kama zulia la kijani lililotandikwa kwa upendo.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum"?" with "Kituo kilikuwa kizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum"?
example.correct_answer: Bustani ya kituo ilikuwa kama zulia la kijani lililotandikwa kwa upendo.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum"?" with "Kituo kilikuwa kizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum"?
example.correct_answer: Bustani ya kituo ilikuwa kama zulia la kijani lililotandikwa kwa upendo.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum"?" with "Kituo kilikuwa kizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Bustani ya kituo ilikuwa kama zulia la kijani lililotandikwa kwa upendo.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Kituo cha Watoto Wenye Mahitaji Maalum", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vivumishi (Theme 7: Kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum)
learning_experiences: kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi kwenye chati, kadi maneno au kapu maneno akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutenga vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi katika orodha ya maneno, sentensi au vifungu kwa kuzipigia mstari au kuzikolezea wino katika matini za kidijitali au za kimaandishi,
kumtajia mwenzake vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi katika mazingira ya shuleni,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum,
kumtajia mzazi au mlezi sentensi zenye vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kuna tofauti gani kati ya vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapochangia shughuli za ujifunzaji na kuchambua aina mbalimbali za vivumishi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutenga vivumishi lengwa.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia vivumishi vya idadi na vimilikishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vivumishi vya idadi na vimilikishi na kuzitungia sentensi na vifungu sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia vivumishi vya idadi na vimilikishi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kuhudumia wenye mahitaji maalum na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies na Religious Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi katika matini
kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua vivumishi vimilikishi na vya idadi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kivumishi kimilikishi (kitabu changu, nyumba yake) na cha idadi (watoto wawili, vitabu vitatu) kinachofuata nomino. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Mixes possessive and number.

example.question: Ni kivumishi kimilikishi kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "wawili" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Wangu ni kivumishi kimilikishi.
misconceptions.feedback: Wangu ni kivumishi kimilikishi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Mixes number and possessive.

example.question: Ni kivumishi cha idadi kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "wangu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Watatu ni kivumishi cha idadi.
misconceptions.feedback: Watatu ni kivumishi cha idadi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts it before the noun.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imepangwa sawa?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Wawili watoto" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kivumishi hufuata nomino.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi hufuata nomino.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts the number before the possessive (watoto wawili wangu) where Kiswahili usually says watoto wangu wawili.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa kawaida?

misconceptions.cause: English "my two children" is read as noun + number + possessive by some.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa kawaida?" with "watoto wawili wangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Usual order: noun + possessive + number: watoto wangu wawili.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa kawaida kimilikishi hutangulia idadi: watoto wangu wawili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Uzungumzaji wa Papo kwa Hapo (Theme 8: Uhalifu wa mtandaoni)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya mazungumzo ya papo kwa hapo,
kubainisha vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo,

kusikiliza uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa yakitolewa na mwalimu, wenzake, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali na kutathmini vipengele vya uwasilishaji vilivyotumika,
kushiriki katika uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo,
kubuni uzungumzaji mwepesi wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo na kuwawasilishia wenzake ili wautathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia mambo gani ili kufanikisha uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojieleza kwa njia wazi katika uwasilishaji wa uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutoa uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo na kujifunza zaidi kuhusu uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapoihusisha hadhira katika uzungumzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake na kutoa mchango katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wengine katika uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa kwa utulivu.
sub_strands.pcis:
Masuala ya usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utunzi na usalama wa watoto: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo katika somo la Kiswahili na uzungumzaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la uhalifu wa mitandaoni na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo ili kuupambanua
kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo
kutoa uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uzungumzaji
kuchangamkia kutoa uzungumzaji wa papo kwa hapo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Zungumza papo kwa hapo kwa mpangilio
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (papo), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on jinsi ya kujikinga na wezi wa mtandaoni, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

misconceptions.error: Starts talking with no plan and loses the point (ummm... na... ummm).

example.question: Umepewa mada ghafla. Ufanye nini kwanza?
example.correct_answer: fikiri hoja tatu kwa sekunde chache, kisha anza

misconceptions.cause: Impromptu is taken to mean unplanned.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Umepewa mada ghafla. Ufanye nini kwanza?" with "anza kuzungumza mara moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise a ten-second plan: mwanzo, hoja mbili, mwisho.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga hoja chache kichwani kabla ya kuanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Fills every pause with "ee", "aa", "si" or "like".

example.question: Ni lipi bora unapotafuta neno?

misconceptions.cause: Silence feels like failure.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi bora unapotafuta neno?" with "kusema "ee... aa..." kila mara" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Count fillers in a recorded talk; try again with pauses.
misconceptions.feedback: Ni bora kunyamaza kidogo kuliko kusema "ee" kila mara.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers or speaks on something other than the topic (jinsi ya kujikinga na wezi wa mtandaoni).

example.question: Mada ni jinsi ya kujikinga na wezi wa mtandaoni. Ni mchango upi unafaa?
example.correct_answer: Tunaweza kuchangia jinsi ya kujikinga na wezi wa mtandaoni kwa njia hii...

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni jinsi ya kujikinga na wezi wa mtandaoni. Ni mchango upi unafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama filamu nzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the topic before speaking; link your point to it in the first sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Changia kuhusu mada inayojadiliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or English words in a formal talk.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?

misconceptions.cause: The child talks as with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika mazungumzo rasmi?" with "Ma-guys, hii issue ni serious." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record and replay; replace each non-Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia (Theme 8: Uhalifu wa mtandaoni)
learning_experiences: kutambua mandhari mbalimbali katika tamthilia akishirikiana na wenzake,
kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari katika tamthilia akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuandika kwa ufupi kuhusu mandhari katika tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu mandhari,
kusoma chapisho la tamthilia au kutoka mtandaoni na kutambua mandhari yake,
kutambua ploti ya tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kujadili na wenzake umuhimu wa ploti ya tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuandaa muhtasari kuhusu ploti ya tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani uchambuzi wake kuhusu ploti ya tamthilia aliyosoma,
kumweleza mzazi au mlezi kuhusu mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia aliyosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mandhari gani unayokumbuka yaliyo katika tamthilia ulizowahi kusoma?
Ploti ina umuhimu gani katika tamthilia ulizowahi kusoma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili na kuchambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha kazi yake darasani.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapochanganua habari katika tamthilia ili kupata mandhari na ploti.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapoeleza au kujadili umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafiti muhtasari wa mandhari na ploti.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake wanapotambua na kujadili mandhari na ploti kwenye tamthilia.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotoa maoni kuhusu uwasilishaji wa wengine ili kuwarekebisha na kuwahimiza.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposoma na kuchanganua tamthilia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine ili kutambua na kujadili mandhari na ploti kwenye tamthilia.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai: mwanafunzi anaposoma tamthilia na kuchambua mandhari na ploti.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la uhalifu wa mitandaoni na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia
kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ili kuubanisha
kujadili mandhari na ploti ya tamthilia aliyosoma
kuchangamkia nafasi ya mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia

skills.name: Eleza mandhari na ploti ya tamthilia
skills.mastery: Explains the mandhari of a tamthilia read in class ("Kilio cha Msitu") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 mandhari and ploti of a novela.

misconceptions.error: Gives only the place as mandhari, and leaves out the time and the social setting.

example.question: Mandhari ya "Kilio cha Msitu" ni yapi?
example.correct_answer: kijiji cha Msitu Mweusi, wakati wa kampeni za uchaguzi

misconceptions.cause: Mandhari is first taught as "mahali".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mandhari ya "Kilio cha Msitu" ni yapi?" with "kijiji cha Msitu Mweusi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make three boxes: mahali, wakati, hali ya kijamii; fill each from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Mandhari ni mahali, wakati na hali ambamo matukio yanatokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a list of the characters, or a summary of the message, as the ploti.

example.question: Ploti ya "Kilio cha Msitu" ni nini?
example.wrong_answer: orodha ya wahusika: Bi. Zuhura na Kazungu
example.correct_answer: mfuatano wa matukio tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: Ploti is a new word and the child grabs what he knows about the work.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ploti ya "Kilio cha Msitu" ni nini?" with "orodha ya wahusika: Bi. Zuhura na Kazungu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ploti is the chain of events with cause: because A, then B. Build it with event cards and arrows.
misconceptions.feedback: Ploti ni msuko wa matukio na jinsi yanavyofuatana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events of the ploti in the order he remembers them, not the order of the story.

example.question: Ni tukio lipi huja kwanza katika ploti ya "Kilio cha Msitu"?
example.correct_answer: tukio la mwanzo kabisa la kazi

misconceptions.cause: The climax is remembered first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tukio lipi huja kwanza katika ploti ya "Kilio cha Msitu"?" with "Zuhura anazuia malori ya mbao" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the events on the page; then check the order against the chapters or scenes.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa matukio kama yalivyo katika kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the mandhari but cannot say why it matters to the story (it is "just where it happened").

example.question: Mandhari ya kijiji cha Msitu Mweusi yana umuhimu gani katika "Kilio cha Msitu"?
example.correct_answer: yanaonyesha hali ya wahusika na kuchangia uharibifu wa mazingira na ufisadi

misconceptions.cause: Setting has been taught as a fact to find, not as a tool of the author.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mandhari ya kijiji cha Msitu Mweusi yana umuhimu gani katika "Kilio cha Msitu"?" with "ni mahali tu hadithi ilipotokea" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: could the story happen the same way anywhere else? What does this place add?
misconceptions.feedback: Mandhari hujenga hali, huonyesha maudhui na huathiri matendo ya wahusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viakifishi (Theme 8: Uhalifu wa mtandaoni)
learning_experiences: kutambua matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari kwenye matini andishi au za kidijitali,
kuandika maneno, sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo,
kuandika kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali kifungu kifupi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo na kuwasambazia wenzake kwenye mtandao ili wakitolee maoni,
kushirikiana na wenzake kusahihisha kifungu ambacho hakijatumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo,
kuwasomea wenzake kifungu alichoandika na kuwataka waandike maneno, sentensi au vifungu vinavyostahili kuwa na alama za mtajo na mshazari,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kutafiti mtandaoni au kwenye vitabu vya ziada kuhusu matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, alama za mtajo hutumiwa vipi katika maandishi?
Je, alama ya mshazari hutumiwa vipi katika maandishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika kifungu na kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika vifungu vyenye matumizi yafaayo ya alama za mtajo na mshazari.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kutafiti kuhusu matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Masuala ya usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi na vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Usalama wa watoto: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi na vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.

Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la uhalifu wa mitandaoni na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 8: Uhalifu wa mtandaoni)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I katika sentensi na mafungu ya maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I,
kuchopoa nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au katika tarakilishi,
kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira ya shuleni yaliyo katika ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I,
kutenga nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I katika orodha ya nomino, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vyenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la uhalifu wa mtandaoni,
kutunga sentensi zenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I akitumia nomino za vitu vilivyo katika mazingira ya nyumbani, na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako vyenye majina yaliyo katika ngeli ya I-ZI?

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi au vifungu akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuunda sentensi au vifungu kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizounda kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI na I-I katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Kina (Theme 9: Majukumu ya mnunuzi)
learning_experiences: kutambua sauti /ch/ na /sh/katika maneno na silabi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutambua maneno yenye sauti /ch/ na /sh/ katika matini andishi au za kidijitali na kuyatamka ipasavyo,
kutunga vitanzandimi vyenye maana akitumia sauti /ch/ na /sh/na kujirekodi kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali,
kusikiliza na wenzake vitanzandimi alivyovirekodi ili kuvitathmini,
kumwasilishia mzazi au mlezi mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya sauti /ch/ na /sh/.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno yapi unayoyajua yaliyo na sauti /ch/ na /sh/?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia katika shughuli za kutafuta maneno yenye sauti /ch/ na /sh/ katika matini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kusikiliza vitanza ndimi vyenye sauti /ch/ na /sh/.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kutofautisha matamshi kuhusu sauti lengwa na pia anapotunga sentensi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotamka ipasavyo sauti /ch/ na /sh/na anapochangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo na mzazi au mlezi kwa kuhusisha matamshi bora ya sauti /ch/ na /sh/.

kutamka sauti /ch/ na /sh/ipasavyo katika silabi na maneno

skills.name: Tofautisha sauti /ch/ na /sh/ katika silabi, maneno na vitanzandimi
skills.mastery: Hears, says and writes the right sound in syllables and words with /ch/ na /sh/ (chaka and shaka, chali and shali), picks the word that matches the meaning, and tells a real kitanzandimi from an ordinary sentence, in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Hears or says /sh/ for /ch/, so chaka (a thicket) becomes shaka (doubt).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "chaka". Umesikia neno lipi?

misconceptions.cause: Several Kenyan first languages (Dholuo among them) have no /sh/ and say s or ch, so the child hears ch and sh as one sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "chaka". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "shaka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "chaka" ina sauti /ch/. "shaka" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (shali where chali is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "lying on one's back".

misconceptions.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "lying on one's back"." with "shali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "lying on one's back" ni "chali". "shali" lina maana ya "a shawl".
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "chali" na "shali" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

misconceptions.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""chali" na "shali" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hapana. "chali" ni lying on one's back, na "shali" ni a shawl.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.wrong_answer: Mnunuzi aangalie tarehe ya mwisho wa matumizi.
example.correct_answer: Shaban alishangaa chai ya Shani ilichemka chini ya shamba la Chacha.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Mnunuzi aangalie tarehe ya mwisho wa matumizi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /ch/ na /sh/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Breaks the word into syllables at the wrong place, so the target sound is lost (ch-aka read as two wrong parts).

example.question: Neno "chaka" lina silabi zipi?

misconceptions.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "chaka" lina silabi zipi?" with "c-haka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: cha-ka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 9: Majukumu ya mnunuzi)
learning_experiences: kusoma ufahamu wa kifungu cha kushawishi kutoka kwa vitabu au vifaa vya kidijitali na kudondoa habari mahususi (k.v. nani, nini, wapi, lini),
kutabiri matukio katika kifungu cha ufahamu cha kushawishi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kueleza maana ya msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. maneno na nahau) katika kifungu cha ufahamu cha kushawishi na kuueleza kwa kutumia kamusi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadili ushawishi katika kifungu cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuwawasilishia wenzake kazi yake ili wamtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni kwa njia gani tunaweza kutambua ujumbe wenye lengo la kushawishi katika habari?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili ushawishi katika kifungu cha ufahamu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kupata matini mbalimbali na kuzisoma na kudondoa habari mahususi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotabiri matukio katika kifungu cha ufahamu cha kushawishi.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotagusana na wenzake ili kujadili ushawishi katika kifungu cha ufahamu.
sub_strands.pcis:

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 9: Majukumu ya mnunuzi)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vinavyozingatiwa kujenga wazo (k.v. mada, utangulizi, mwili, hitimisho) katika insha ya masimulizi kwenye matini za kimaandishi na za kidijitali,
kutambua ukuzaji wa wazo katika kila aya ya insha ya masimulizi katika matini za kimaandishi au za kidijitali,

kueleza jinsi wazo lilivyokuzwa katika kila aya ya insha ya masimulizi (k.v. kila wazo kuu kuwa katika aya yake, kutoa maelezo toshelevu kwa kila hoja kuu katika aya yake, kuepuka urudiaji au uchanganyaji wa hoja katika aya),
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vinavyojenga mawazo,
kuandika vidokezo vya insha vinavyozingatia ukuzaji wa wazo katika kila aya,

kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika au kuwasambazia kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni,

Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.
Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majukumu ya mnunuzi na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Pre-Technical Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vinavyozingatiwa kujenga wazo katika insha ya masimulizi
kujadili vipengele vinavyojenga wazo katika aya kuhusu insha ya masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi akikuza wazo katika aya ipasavyo
kufurahia utunzi wa insha za masimulizi zenye mpangilio mzuri wa wazo

skills.name: Andika insha ya masimulizi ukikuza wazo katika kila aya
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya kubuni from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a creative story built paragraph by paragraph, with characters, a setting and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 built one idea per paragraph in a masimulizi.

misconceptions.error: Puts several ideas in one paragraph, or one idea across many tiny paragraphs, so no idea is built up.

example.question: Aya nzuri ya insha "Bidhaa Bandia Sokoni" ina nini?
example.correct_answer: wazo moja kuu linalokuzwa kwa maelezo na mifano

misconceptions.cause: Paragraphs are made where the child pauses, not where an idea ends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Aya nzuri ya insha "Bidhaa Bandia Sokoni" ina nini?" with "mawazo mengi tofauti" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Topic sentence first; then two or three sentences that develop only it; a link to the next paragraph.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila aya ikuze wazo moja kuu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Switches between "I" and "he" for the narrator, or between views, in one insha.

example.question: Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?
example.correct_answer: kutumia nafsi moja ya msimulizi tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets who is telling the story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi ni kosa katika insha moja?" with "kuanza "nilikwenda..." kisha "alikwenda..." kwa msimulizi yuleyule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Decide the narrator before writing; circle every verb of the narrator and check the person.
misconceptions.feedback: Dumisha nafsi na mtazamo mmoja wa msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Bidhaa Bandia Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: tuliripoti kwa mamlaka, nilirudi dukani, iliharibika siku ya pili, nilinunua simu
example.correct_answer: nilinunua simu, iliharibika siku ya pili, nilirudi dukani, tuliripoti kwa mamlaka

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Bidhaa Bandia Sokoni"?" with "tuliripoti kwa mamlaka, nilirudi dukani, iliharibika siku ya pili, nilinunua simu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts English or Sheng words in the insha (tulienda kwa party, mathe, form).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?

misconceptions.cause: The child speaks a mixed language at home and with friends and does not notice the switch in writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?" with "Mathe alinipea form ya kujaza." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline each non-Kiswahili word; find the Kiswahili word together (mama, sherehe, fomu).
misconceptions.feedback: Insha huandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu, bila maneno ya Kiingereza wala Sheng.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 9: Majukumu ya mnunuzi)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya U-U na U-YA katika sentensi na vifungu vya maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-U na U-YA,
kuchopoa nomino za ngeli ya U-U na U-YA kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au katika tarakilishi,
kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira ya shuleni yaliyo katika ngeli ya U-U na U-YA,
kutenga nomino za ngeli ya U-U na U-YA katika orodha ya nomino, sentensi au vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi, chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi vyenye upatanisho ufaao wa ngeli ya U-U na U-YA akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la majukumu ya mnunuzi,
kuwasilisha kazi yake darasani au kuwasambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni,
kutunga sentensi zenye upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-U na U-YA akitumia nomino za vitu vilivyo katika mazingira ya nyumbani, na kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako vyenye majina yaliyo katika ngeli ya U-U?
Ni vitu gani katika mazingira yako vyenye majina yaliyo katika ngeli ya U-YA?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-U na U-YA.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuunda sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-U na U-YA.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizounda kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-U na U-YA katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-U na U-YA.
Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli na upatanisho wa kisarufi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majukumu ya mnunuzi na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Pre-Technical Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-U na U-YA katika sentensi
kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-U na U-YA katika matini
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-U na U-YA katika matini kwa kuzingatia upatanisho ufaao wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya U-U na U-YA ipasavyo ili kuimarisha umilisi wa lugha

skills.name: Tumia ngeli za U-U na U-YA na upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua nomino za U-U (uji, ugali, unga, upendo) zinazotumia u-: uji umeiva, na za U-YA (ugonjwa, magonjwa) zinazotumia u- na ya-: ugonjwa unaumiza, magonjwa yanaumiza. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.error: Uses ki- for uji.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Uji kimeiva." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Uji ni wa U-U na hutumia u-.
misconceptions.feedback: Uji ni wa U-U na hutumia u-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses u- for the plural.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi kwa wingi.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Magonjwa unaumiza." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Wingi wa U-YA hutumia ya-.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa U-YA hutumia ya-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Names a wrong noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kitabu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Ugali ni wa U-U.
misconceptions.feedback: Ugali ni wa U-U.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Puts a U-YA or U-U noun in U-ZI (Ugonjwa huu -> Ngonjwa hizi).

example.question: Wingi wa "ugonjwa huu" ni?

misconceptions.cause: U-ZI (ukuta/kuta) is learnt first and its plural rule is copied.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "ugonjwa huu" ni?" with "ngonjwa hizi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Test the plural: ma- means U-YA (magonjwa); no plural means U-U (uji).
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa ugonjwa ni magonjwa: U-YA.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hadithi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na hisia)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza kielelezo cha hadithi ya hurafa na hekaya kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kueleza maana ya hurafa na hekaya ili kuzibainisha,
kueleza ujumbe katika hurafa na hekaya,
kujadili na mwenzake vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa hurafa na hekaya,
kuwasilisha hurafa na hekaya kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji (kiini cha hadithi, kiwango cha lugha, mpangilio wa matukio, sauti, ishara za mwili),
kujirekodi akitamba hurafa na hekaya kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali na kusikiliza,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kutambua hurafa na hekaya kutoka kwa jamii yake na kujadili ujumbe unaojitokeza katika hadithi hizo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, hadithi ambayo umewahi kusikiliza ilihusu wanyama gani?
Je, hurafa na hekaya hutofautianaje?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposimulia hurafa na hekaya na kuwashirikisha wenzake katika masimulizi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia hurafa na hekaya.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposimulia hurafa na hekaya kwa wenzake kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya kimsingi vya uwasilishaji.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasilisha hurafa na hekaya ipasavyo kwa wenzake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposimulia hurafa na hekaya akiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake na kuchangamkia kutafiti zaidi kuhusu hadithi za masimulizi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu: mwanafunzi anaposimulia hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Masuala ya afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anaposimulia hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uwasilishaji wa hurafa na hekaya katika somo la Kiswahili na uwasilishaji huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na hisia na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.
