outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya hurafa na hekaya ili kuzibainisha
kueleza ujumbe katika hurafa na hekaya
kujadili vipengele vya uwasilishaji wa hurafa na hekaya
kusimulia hurafa na hekaya kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uwasilishaji
kufurahia hurafa na hekaya kama vipera vya fasihi simulizi

skills.name: Eleza maana, aina na sifa za hadithi
skills.mastery: Explains the maana of hadithi (hurafa, hekaya) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 tanzu and vipera of fasihi.

misconceptions.error: Mixes the two kinds (hurafa and hekaya) and their purposes.

example.question: "Sungura na Fisi waliogawana mavuno" ni hadithi ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both are hadithi; the child has not fixed what each is for and when it is used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Sungura na Fisi waliogawana mavuno" ni hadithi ya aina gani?" with "hekaya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List for each kind: who uses it, when, and why; sort examples.
misconceptions.feedback: "Sungura na Fisi waliogawana mavuno" ni hurafa: ujanja wa kudanganya huleta adhabu; tushirikiane kwa haki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls hadithi written literature because it is found in a textbook.

example.question: Hadithi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child meets it on the page in class.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hadithi ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?" with "fasihi andishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who first made it, and how was it passed on? By mouth, from one generation to the next.
misconceptions.feedback: Hadithi ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Places the hadithi in the wrong occasion (a lullaby at a work party, a work song at a funeral).

example.question: Hurafa hutumika lini?

misconceptions.cause: The occasion is not stated in the text, and the child does not link form to use.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hurafa hutumika lini?" with "wakati wowote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the occasion; which kind fits it?
misconceptions.feedback: Hurafa hutumika jioni kuburudisha na kufunza watoto.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a line of the text as its message instead of the lesson.

example.question: Ujumbe wa "Sungura na Fisi waliogawana mavuno" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: ujanja wa kudanganya huleta adhabu; tushirikiane kwa haki.

misconceptions.cause: Copying a line feels like a safe answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa "Sungura na Fisi waliogawana mavuno" ni upi?" with "Sungura na Fisi waliogawana mavuno" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Close the text; say the lesson in your own words.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na hisia)
learning_experiences: kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyoisoma,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuigiza wahusika katika tamthilia akiwa na wenzake ili kukuza uelewa wa sifa zao,
kueleza uhusiano kati ya wahusika katika tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kutazama video kuhusu wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma,
kuandaa muhtasari kuhusu sifa za wahusika katika video aliyotazama,
kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na matendo ya wahusika akishirikiana na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo yapi yanayokuelekeza kuwaelewa wahusika katika tamthilia?
Je, ni mambo gani tunayoweza kujifunza kutokana na wahusika wa tamthilia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili sifa za wahusika.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza na wenzake wahusika katika tamthilia.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotazama video kuhusu wahusika katika tamthilia.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza wahusika katika tamthilia.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochambua sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapochambua tamthilia.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua majukumu mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu: mwanafunzi anaposoma tamthilia na kuchambua wahusika waliomo.
Masuala mtambuko anuwai: mwanafunzi anaposoma tamthilia.

Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya wahusika katika tamthilia ya Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma
kujadili sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia
kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na wahusika katika tamthilia
kujenga mazoea ya usomaji wa kazi za kifasihi ili kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji

skills.name: Chambua wahusika na sifa zao katika tamthilia
skills.mastery: Explains the wahusika of a tamthilia read in class ("Kilio cha Msitu") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Setting and plot frame the characters.

misconceptions.error: Takes a minor character who appears often for the main character.

example.question: Mhusika mkuu katika "Kilio cha Msitu" ni nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child counts appearances, not who the story is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mhusika mkuu katika "Kilio cha Msitu" ni nani?" with "Kazungu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whose problem the story follows from start to end.
misconceptions.feedback: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye kazi inamhusu tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a trait with no action from the text to show it.

example.question: Bi. Zuhura ni jasiri. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?
example.wrong_answer: ni jasiri kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri
example.correct_answer: alisimama mbele ya malori ya mbao akakataa yapite

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a trait must be named but not that it must be shown.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Bi. Zuhura ni jasiri. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?" with "ni jasiri kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use the frame: trait + "kwa sababu" + an action from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sifa ithibitishwe kwa kitendo cha mhusika katika kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives how the character looks (mrefu, mrembo) when the character's nature is asked.

example.question: Taja sifa ya kitabia ya Bi. Zuhura.

misconceptions.cause: Describing people starts with appearance in lower grades.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Taja sifa ya kitabia ya Bi. Zuhura." with "mrefu na mwembamba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two columns: sura (looks) and tabia (character); sort the words.
misconceptions.feedback: Sifa za kitabia ni kama ukarimu, uchoyo, ujasiri; si urefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the behaviour of a bad character as the lesson to copy.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na matendo ya Mzee Tamaa?
example.correct_answer: tuepuke tabia mbaya kama zake kwa sababu zina madhara

misconceptions.cause: The bad character often wins for a while, and the child sees the gain, not the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na matendo ya Mzee Tamaa?" with "tufanye kama yeye ili tufanikiwe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Follow the character to the end of the work: what did his actions bring?
misconceptions.feedback: Tunajifunza kuepuka tabia mbaya kwa kuona matokeo yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msaada (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na hisia)
learning_experiences: kujadili vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada,
kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada,
kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada kuhusu masuala mbalimbali na kuwasomea wenzake darasani ili waitolee maoni,
kuandika barua ya kuomba msaada katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwasambazia wenzake kupitia mtandao ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je ni mambo gani yanayoweza kukufanya kuomba msaada?
Je, ni vipengele vipi unazingatia wakati unapoandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kutoa mchango wake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika barua na kuisambaza kwa mtandao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada
kutambua ujumbe katika barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada
kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, muundo na lugha ifaayo
kufurahia kujieleza ifaavyo kwa njia ya barua

skills.name: Tambua muundo wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi (anwani mbili, tarehe, salamu rasmi, kichwa, ujumbe, hitimisho) na kuwa lugha yake ni ya heshima. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

skills.name: Andika barua rasmi ya kuomba msaada
skills.mastery: Tells barua rasmi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an official letter with two addresses, the date, a formal greeting, a KUH: line, the message and Wako mtiifu with a signature; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The parts of a letter asking for help.

misconceptions.error: Gives one address.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "moja" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the heading.

example.question: Barua rasmi huwa na nini kabla ya ujumbe?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "hakuna kitu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua rasmi ina kichwa cha barua.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina kichwa cha barua.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Uses slang.

example.question: Lugha ya barua rasmi ni ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ya mtaani" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha ya heshima.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha ya heshima.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Writes only one address, or puts the receiver's address at the top right.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi (kulia juu) na ya mpokeaji (kushoto)

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter has one address and the child carries it over.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" with "moja, ya mwandishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label both addresses on a model; the child writes his own and the receiver's on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the subject line (KUH: or YAH:) or writes it as a long sentence.

example.question: Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la msaada wa ushauri nasaha?
example.wrong_answer: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
example.correct_answer: KUH: OMBI LA MSAADA WA USHAURI NASAHA

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the reader of an official letter needs the subject before reading.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la msaada wa ushauri nasaha?" with "Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the KUH: line on three real letters; it is short and in capitals.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses friendly words in an official letter (Mpendwa rafiki, Hujambo?, Wako akupendaye).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

misconceptions.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes the problem at length but never says clearly what help is asked for.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni kiini cha barua ya kuomba msaada?
example.wrong_answer: Nimekuwa na matatizo mengi nyumbani na shuleni.
example.correct_answer: Naomba nipangiwe kikao na mshauri wa wanafunzi wiki hii.

misconceptions.cause: The child explains but is shy to ask.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni kiini cha barua ya kuomba msaada?" with "Nimekuwa na matatizo mengi nyumbani na shuleni." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: the problem in brief, the exact request, why it would help.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kuomba msaada hueleza wazi msaada unaoombwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na hisia)
learning_experiences: kujadili maana ya kinyume akiwa na mwenzake,
kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi kwa kutumia kadi maneno, mti maneno au kapu maneno,
kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika matini (k.v. orodha ya maneno, sentensi na vifungu vya maneno),
kuchagua sentensi zinazoashiria matumizi ya vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi kutoka kwa sentensi mbalimbali kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi au chati,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi akitumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la kukabiliana na hisia,
kusakura mtandaoni au kutafiti katika vitabu vya ziada ili kupata vinyume zaidi vya vitenzi na vielezi,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi sentensi alizotunga kuhusu vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vinyume gani vya vitenzi unavyojua?
Je, unajua vinyume gani vya vielezi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuonyesha vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi/mlezi wake sentensi alizotunga kuonyesha vinyume vya vitenzi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya kinyume ili kuibainisha
kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika matini
kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi
skills.mastery: Mtoto hueleza kinyume ni neno lenye maana kinyume na hutambua vinyume vya vitenzi (fungua na funga, nunua na uza) na vya vielezi (juu na chini, mbele na nyuma, polepole na haraka). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.error: Gives a wrong verb antonym.

example.question: Kinyume cha fungua ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "nunua" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha fungua ni funga.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha fungua ni funga.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives a wrong adverb antonym.

example.question: Kinyume cha polepole ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "chini" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha polepole ni haraka.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha polepole ni haraka.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives a wrong antonym of nunua.

example.question: Kinyume cha nunua ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kinyume cha nunua ni uza.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha nunua ni uza.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the negative of the verb or adverb (hakununua, si haraka) as its opposite.

example.question: Kinyume cha "haraka" ni?

misconceptions.cause: Negation feels like the opposite.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "haraka" ni?" with "si haraka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: An opposite is another word: haraka/polepole, nunua/uza, juu/chini.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume ni neno lingine lenye maana kinyume: polepole.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kuzungumza kwa Kutumia Vidokezo vya Hoja (Theme 11: Haki za watoto)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya kuzungumza kwa kutumia vidokezo vya hoja,
kujadili na wenzake umuhimu wa kuzungumza kwa kutumia vidokezo vya hoja,
kutambua miktadha katika jamii yake ambamo anahitaji kuzungumza kwa kutumia vidokezo vya hoja,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kuzungumza kwa kutumia vidokezo vya hoja,
kusikiliza au kutazama aina mbalimbali za mazungumzo kutoka kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali, mgeni mwalikwa au wenzake na kubainisha vipengele vilivyozingatiwa,
kuandaa vidokezo kuhusu suala lengwa,
kuwawasilishia wenzake mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia vidokezo alivyoandaa ili wayatolee maoni,
kumwasilishia mzazi au mlezi vidokezo vya mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa ili atoe maoni yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini ni muhimu kuandaa vidokezo unapozungumza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuwasilisha mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandaa vidokezo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowawasilishia wenzake mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza au kutazama aina mbalimbali za mazungumzo na kubainisha vipengele vilivyozingatiwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake zamu ya kushiriki katika mazungumzo bila kuwakata kauli.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapovitunza vifaa vya kidijitali alivyotumia kujifunzia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.

Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anapozungumza kuhusu suala lengwa.

kutambua miktadha katika jamii ambapo kuzungumza kwa kutumia vidokezo vya hoja hufanywa

skills.name: Zungumza kwa kutumia vidokezo vya hoja
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (vidokezo), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on haki ya mtoto kupata elimu, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

prerequisites.reason: Impromptu speaking comes before speaking from notes.
Building one idea per paragraph is the same planning.

misconceptions.error: Reads the notes word for word instead of speaking from them.

example.question: Vidokezo vya hoja hutumiwaje?
example.correct_answer: kukumbusha hoja huku ukizungumza na hadhira

misconceptions.cause: Notes look like a script.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Vidokezo vya hoja hutumiwaje?" with "kusomwa neno kwa neno" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write only key words on the card; speak a sentence from each.
misconceptions.feedback: Vidokezo ni maneno machache ya kukumbusha, si hotuba ya kusoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Speaks the points in random order, not the order of the notes.

example.question: Hoja zako zifuate mpangilio gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets the plan under pressure.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hoja zako zifuate mpangilio gani?" with "kama zinavyokujia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Number the notes; tick each as it is spoken.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa vidokezo vyako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers or speaks on something other than the topic (haki ya mtoto kupata elimu).

example.question: Mada ni haki ya mtoto kupata elimu. Ni mchango upi unafaa?
example.correct_answer: Tunaweza kuchangia haki ya mtoto kupata elimu kwa njia hii...

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni haki ya mtoto kupata elimu. Ni mchango upi unafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama filamu nzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the topic before speaking; link your point to it in the first sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Changia kuhusu mada inayojadiliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 11: Haki za watoto)
learning_experiences: kuteua matini ifaayo ya kujisomea,
kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia aliyoisoma,

kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia (k.v. ya usalama barabarani (mfano; tabia hatarishi kwa watumiaji wengine wa barabara, kutoa maoni na kuripoti kuhusu tabia hatarishi) ya kisayansi, ya kisiasa, ya kihistoria, ya kifasihi,),
kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua,
kujenga rekodi ya msamiati aliojifunza katika kitabu,
kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati katika matini aliyoisoma,
kusakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya ziada kisha aisome.
key_inquiry_questions: Unavutiwa zaidi na nini unaposoma makala ya kujichagulia?
Unazingatia mambo gani wakati wa kusoma makala ya kujichagulia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kuwasilisha muhtasari wa matini aliyojichagulia na kueleza ujumbe wa makala.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini ya kusoma na kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua kwenye kamusi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni na kujichagulia matini ya kusoma.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.

Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa.

sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha kusoma kwa mapana katika somo la Kiswahili na usomaji huo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kuteua matini ifaayo ya kujisomea
kueleza ujumbe katika matini ya kujichagulia
kutambua maana za msamiati na matumizi mengine ya lugha katika matini ya kujichagulia

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 chose and read a text.
Theme 2 the message of a chosen text.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu haki za watoto. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu haki za watoto. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Sauti ya Mtoto" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Sauti ya Mtoto" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Sauti ya Mtoto" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya elimu, ulinzi na kusikilizwa.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Sauti ya Mtoto" ni upi?" with "Sauti ya Mtoto" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu haki za watoto?
example.wrong_answer: Amani alikuwa na miaka kumi na mbili.
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya elimu, ulinzi na kusikilizwa.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu haki za watoto?" with "Amani alikuwa na miaka kumi na mbili." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (dhuluma).

example.question: Katika matini: "Dhuluma dhidi ya watoto lazima iripotiwe." Neno "dhuluma" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Dhuluma dhidi ya watoto lazima iripotiwe." Neno "dhuluma" lina maana gani?" with "zawadi ya siku ya kuzaliwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "dhuluma" hapa ni kunyimwa haki au kutendewa vibaya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 11: Haki za watoto)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo kwa kurejelea matini mbalimbali,
kutafiti maktabani au mtandaoni vipengele vya insha ya maelezo,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya insha ya maelezo alivyotafiti mtandaoni,
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika au kuwasambazia kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni,
kushirikiana na wenzake kusahihisha insha walizoandika na kutoleana maoni kwa amani na upendo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vipengele gani vya kuzingatia katika kuandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusambazia insha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika insha ya maelezo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake kwa ufasaha insha aliyoandika ili waikosoe pamoja.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika insha nzuri na kuwasomea wenzake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo
kuandika insha ya maelezo ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake
kufurahia kuandika insha za maelezo katika maisha ya kila siku

skills.name: Andika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kusoma katika mazingira salama bila kuadhibiwa kikatili.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni"?" with "Watoto wana haki nyingi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kusoma katika mazingira salama bila kuadhibiwa kikatili.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya kusoma katika mazingira salama bila kuadhibiwa kikatili.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Haki za Mtoto Shuleni"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Theme 11: Haki za watoto)
learning_experiences: kutambua vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda mtawalia,
kuteua vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda mtawalia, kwenye chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno au tarakilishi,
kutenga vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda katika sentensi na vifungu kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi au chati kwa kuvikolezea wino au kuvipigia mstari,
kugeuza vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda akizingatia likiwemo suala la haki za watoto.

kuchangamkia kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. masuala mtambuko mbalimbali

skills.name: Tambua kauli za kutendeka, kutendewa na kutendatenda
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kutendeka (pika, pikika), kutendewa (pikiwa) na kutendatenda (pigapiga, tendo linalorudiwa). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

misconceptions.error: Confuses kutendeka with kutendewa.

example.question: Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendeka?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pikiwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Pikika ni kutendeka.
misconceptions.feedback: Pikika ni kutendeka.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Confuses kutendewa with kutendeka.

example.question: Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendewa?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "pikika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Pikiwa ni kutendewa.
misconceptions.feedback: Pikiwa ni kutendewa.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not know the repeated act.

example.question: Pigapiga humaanisha nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kupiga mara moja" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Pigapiga ni kupiga mara nyingi.
misconceptions.feedback: Pigapiga ni kupiga mara nyingi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Repeats the whole word with its prefix (anapigapiga is right; the child writes anapiga-anapiga) or repeats a verb that does not take it.

example.question: Kauli ya kutendatenda ya "anapiga" ni?

misconceptions.cause: Repetition is heard as two words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kauli ya kutendatenda ya "anapiga" ni?" with "anapiga anapiga" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Repeat the stem only, joined: piga -> pigapiga; the prefix once.
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendatenda hurudia mzizi tu: anapigapiga.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusikiliza kwa Makini (Theme 12: Magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza matini kutoka kwa kifaa cha kidijitali au mwalimu wake,
kutambua hoja muhimu katika habari aliyosikiliza kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu, kifaa cha kidijitali, mgeni mwalikwa au wenzake,
kueleza hoja muhimu aliyotambua kutoka matini aliyosikiliza,
kudondoa habari muhimu katika matini aliyosikiliza kwa kufuata mpangilio ufaao,
kukadiria maana ya msamiati mahususi na vifungu katika matini aliyosikiliza,
kuelezea mwenzake maana ya msamiati katika matini ya kusikiliza.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kwa nini ni muhimu kuwa na mpangilio ufaao wa hoja kutoka habari uliyosikiliza?

Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza habari, kuichanganua na kutambua hoja muhimu na kuziwasilisha kwa mpangilio ufaao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoiwasilisha upya habari aliyosikiliza kwa mpangilio ufaao wa hoja.

skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kisukari na shinikizo la damu vinaweza kuzuiwa kwa lishe bora na mazoezi."?
example.wrong_answer: Kisukari ... na ... shinikizo ... la ... damu ... vinaweza ... kuzuiwa ... kwa ... lishe ... bora ... na ... mazoezi.
example.correct_answer: Kisukari na shinikizo la damu vinaweza kuzuiwa kwa lishe bora na mazoezi.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kisukari na shinikizo la damu vinaweza kuzuiwa kwa lishe bora na mazoezi."?" with "Kisukari ... na ... shinikizo ... la ... damu ... vinaweza ... kuzuiwa ... kwa ... lishe ... bora ... na ... mazoezi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, unafanya mazoezi kila siku?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, unafanya mazoezi kila siku?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Hongera, umepunguza sukari mwilini!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Hongera, umepunguza sukari mwilini!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (mazoezi read as masoezi).

example.question: Neno "mazoezi" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "mazoezi" linatamkwa vipi?" with "masoezi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "mazoezi" kama lilivyoandikwa; "masoezi" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kiuamilifu (Theme 12: Magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe (unaolenga kinachotolewa ufafanuzi), lugha (nyepesi inayoeleweka) na muundo ufaao wa hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi,
kujadili na wenzake miktadha inayochochea hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi,
kujadili na wenzake vidokezo vinavyoweza kutumiwa katika kuandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi,
kuandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia ujumbe, lugha na muundo ufaao kisha awasambazie wenzake mtandaoni au kuwasomea darasani ili waitolee maoni,
kuandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi kuhusu suala linaloathiri jamii yao kisha amsomee mzazi au mlezi ili aitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni mambo gani ya kuzingatia katika kutoa hotuba ya ufafanuzi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji kujadili kuhusu vipengele vya kuandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi na kusambazia wenzake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba kuhusu suala lengwa.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapoandika hotuba kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha uandishi wa hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi katika somo la Kiswahili na uandishi huo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Agriculture na Integrated Science.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi
kutambua hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi katika matini
kujadili ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi
kuandika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi kwa kuzingatia vipengele vyake
kuchangamkia nafasi ya hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na andika hotuba ya kutoa ufafanuzi
skills.mastery: Tells hotuba from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a speech with the itifaki, words spoken to the audience, facts the listener can use and a closing with thanks; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 7 wrote a speech to inform.

misconceptions.error: Starts the speech with no greeting of the guests in order (itifaki).

example.question: Hotuba huanza vipi?
example.wrong_answer: moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza
example.correct_answer: kwa itifaki: Mheshimiwa mgeni rasmi, walimu, wazazi...

misconceptions.cause: The child writes a speech like an insha.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hotuba huanza vipi?" with "moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the itifaki line and the order of rank.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huanza kwa itifaki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes about the listeners in the third person instead of speaking to them (Wanafunzi wanapaswa... instead of Wanafunzi wenzangu, tunapaswa...).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba?

misconceptions.cause: The speech is written, so it takes the voice of an essay.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba?" with "Wanafunzi wanapaswa kunawa mikono." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the draft aloud to the class; change every "wao" to "sisi" or "nyinyi".
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba huzungumza na hadhira moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends without thanking the audience or closing (Asanteni kwa kunisikiliza).

example.question: Hotuba humalizika vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child stops when the points run out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Hotuba humalizika vipi?" with "kwa hoja ya mwisho tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model a closing: a call to act and thanks.
misconceptions.feedback: Funga hotuba kwa muhtasari na shukrani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives an information speech with no facts the listener can use (dates, places, steps).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu kisukari ni nini na tunajikingaje?
example.correct_answer: Chanjo itatolewa katika zahanati ya Ruaka kuanzia Jumatatu ijayo.

misconceptions.cause: The child gives feelings, not information.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba ya kupasha habari kuhusu kisukari ni nini na tunajikingaje?" with "Ugonjwa huu ni mbaya sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the speech against nani, nini, lini, wapi, vipi.
misconceptions.feedback: Hotuba ya kupasha habari hutoa ukweli muhimu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Aina za Sentensi (Theme 12: Magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya sentensi changamano,
kutenga sentensi changamano katika orodha ya sentensi kwenye vitabu, chati au tarakilishi kwa kuzipigia mstari au kuzikolezea wino,
kubainisha sentensi changamano zinazojitokeza katika matini,
kutunga sentensi changamano ipasavyo akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa,
kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani sentensi changamano alizotunga ili wazitathmini,
kumtungia mzazi au mlezi sentensi changamano zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni nini tofauti kati ya sentensi changamano na aina zingine za sentensi unazozijua?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua sentensi changamano.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akitumia sentensi changamano.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua sentensi changamano katika kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi changamano zinazohusu shughuli katika mazingira ya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya sentensi changamano katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Agriculture na Integrated Science.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya sentensi changamano ili kuipambanua
kutambua sentensi changamano katika matini
kutumia sentensi changamano ipasavyo katika matini
kuonea fahari matumizi ya sentensi changamano katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua sentensi changamano
skills.mastery: Mtoto hueleza sentensi changamano ina kishazi huru (kinachojitegemea) na kishazi tegemezi (kisichojitegemea), kama "Mtoto aliyeshinda alipewa zawadi". Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 amba-, which starts many dependent clauses.

misconceptions.error: Thinks it has no subordinate clause.

example.question: Sentensi changamano ina nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kishazi kimoja tu" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Changamano ina kishazi huru na tegemezi.
misconceptions.feedback: Changamano ina kishazi huru na tegemezi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Thinks a dependent clause stands alone.

example.question: Kishazi tegemezi hufanya nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "kinajitegemea" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kishazi tegemezi hakijitegemei.
misconceptions.feedback: Kishazi tegemezi hakijitegemei.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Takes a simple sentence as complex.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni changamano?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Mtoto analia." next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Changamano ina kishazi tegemezi.
misconceptions.feedback: Changamano ina kishazi tegemezi.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Calls a sentence with "na" or "lakini" (ambatano) changamano, or a sentence with amba- or -po- ambatano.

example.question: "Mtoto ambaye alianguka amepelekwa hospitali" ni sentensi gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both have more than one verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Mtoto ambaye alianguka amepelekwa hospitali" ni sentensi gani?" with "ambatano" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: can each part stand alone? Two that can: ambatano. One that cannot (amba-, -po-, kwa sababu): changamano.
misconceptions.feedback: Kishazi tegemezi (ambaye alianguka) hufanya sentensi kuwa changamano.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hadithi (Theme 13: Heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine)
learning_experiences: kutambua washiriki katika hadithi inayosimuliwa (k.v. fanani, hadhira),
kutambua wahusika katika hadithi inayosimuliwa,
kutambua sifa za wahusika katika hadithi aliyosikiliza kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kuchambua wahusika katika hadithi aliyosikiliza,
kueleza mafunzo kutokana na wahusika katika hadithi,
kutamba hadithi akiwa na wenzake huku wakichukua majukumu mbalimbali (k.v. fanani, hadhira),
kutunga hadithi fupi ambayo ina wahusika wanyama kuhusu suala lengwa na kuwawasilishia wenzake darasani ili wachambue wahusika,
kuwasilishia mzazi au mlezi uchambuzi wa sifa za wahusika katika hadithi aliyosikiliza.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, hadithi uliyowahi kusimuliwa ilikuwa na wahusika gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuchambua wahusika katika hadithi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia hadithi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni hadithi na kuwawasilishia wenzake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochanganua wahusika na nafasi yao katika hadithi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza nafasi ya mhusika katika hadithi au kusimulia wenzake hadithi kwa ukakamavu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kuchanganua wahusika katika hadithi mbalimbali.
Masuala mtambuko anuwai: mwanafunzi anapochambua hadithi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya wahusika katika hadithi katika somo la Kiswahili na dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua wahusika katika hadithi
kuchambua sifa za wahusika katika hadithi
kueleza mafunzo kutokana na wahusika katika hadithi
kufurahia kushiriki katika uchambuzi wa wahusika katika hadithi

skills.name: Chambua wahusika katika hadithi
skills.mastery: Explains the wahusika of hadithi (hurafa, ngano) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Names a character who only appears once as the main one.

example.question: Mhusika mkuu katika hadithi hii ni nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the most striking name.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mhusika mkuu katika hadithi hii ni nani?" with "mhusika aliyetajwa mara moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whom the whole text is about.
misconceptions.feedback: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye utungo unamhusu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a trait with no line or action as evidence.

example.question: Mzee Busara ni mkarimu. Thibitisha.
example.correct_answer: aliwakaribisha wageni na kuwapikia chakula chao

misconceptions.cause: Naming the trait feels like the answer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mzee Busara ni mkarimu. Thibitisha." with "kwa sababu ni mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Frame: sifa + kwa sababu + action.
misconceptions.feedback: Thibitisha sifa kwa kitendo au maneno ya mhusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an animal character literally, not as standing for people (Sungura is just a hare).

example.question: Katika hadithi, Mzee Busara anawakilisha nini?
example.correct_answer: watu wenye tabia kama zake katika jamii

misconceptions.cause: Animal characters look like animal facts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika hadithi, Mzee Busara anawakilisha nini?" with "mnyama wa porini tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask which people in the community behave like this character.
misconceptions.feedback: Wahusika wanyama huwakilisha tabia za watu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Draws the wrong lesson from a character (copy the trickster because he won).

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na mhusika mjanja aliyeadhibiwa mwishoni?

misconceptions.cause: The trick is remembered; the ending is not.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na mhusika mjanja aliyeadhibiwa mwishoni?" with "tuwe wajanja ili tushinde" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the character to the end: what did he gain and lose?
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo hutokana na matokeo ya matendo ya mhusika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia (Theme 13: Heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine)
learning_experiences: kutambua mbinu za lugha kwenye tamthilia,
kueleza umuhimu wa mbinu za lugha zilizotumiwa katika tamthilia iliyoteuliwa na mwalimu,
kuhakiki uwasilishaji wa wenzake kuhusu mbinu za lugha katika tamthilia na kuutolea maoni,
kufanya utafiti maktabani au mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika tamthilia,
kuwasilishia mzazi au mlezi uchambuzi wa matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika tamthilia aliyosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Tamthilia hutumia mbinu gani za lugha?
Mbinu za lugha zina umuhimu gani katika tamthilia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutambua na kujadiliana kuhusu mbinu za lugha katika tamthilia aliyosoma.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowasilishia wenzake muhtasari wa matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika tamthilia kwa kutetea hoja zake.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapofanya utafiti maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu matumizi ya tamathali za lugha katika tamthilia aliyoisoma.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana vizuri na wenzake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapochukua jukumu la kutafiti kuhusu matumizi ya mbinu za lugha maktabani na mtandaoni.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: anuwai: mwanafunzi anaposoma tamthilia.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha mbinu za lugha katika somo la Kiswahili na mbinu hizo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine na yale amejifunza kuhusu suala hilo katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua mbinu za lugha katika tamthilia
kueleza umuhimu wa mbinu za lugha zilizotumiwa katika tamthilia
kufurahia kuchanganua matumizi ya mbinu za lugha katika fasihi

skills.name: Tambua mbinu za lugha na umuhimu wake katika tamthilia
skills.mastery: Explains the mbinu of a tamthilia read in class ("Kilio cha Msitu") with a correct term, gives evidence from the text for every point, and says why it matters to the work, in 8 of 10 new items (longer written answers marked by the teacher).

misconceptions.error: Calls a comparison with kama a sitiari, or one without kama a tashbihi.

example.question: "Mzee Tamaa ni chatu anayemeza msitu" ni mbinu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both compare; the child has not fixed which one uses kama, mithili ya or kana kwamba.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Mzee Tamaa ni chatu anayemeza msitu" ni mbinu gani?" with "tashbihi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle kama, mithili ya, kana kwamba: present means tashbihi; absent means sitiari.
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kama au mithili ya; sitiari hulinganisha moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the device but cannot say what it does in the work.

example.question: Mbinu ya sitiari katika "Mzee Tamaa ni chatu anayemeza msitu" ina umuhimu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Devices have been taught as labels to find.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mbinu ya sitiari katika "Mzee Tamaa ni chatu anayemeza msitu" ina umuhimu gani?" with "ni sitiari" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Always add "inasaidia..." after the label: picture, feeling, stress, humour.
misconceptions.feedback: Eleza kazi ya mbinu: inajenga picha, inasisitiza, inaonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a figure of speech literally.

example.question: "Mzee Tamaa ni chatu anayemeza msitu" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the words, not the picture.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Mzee Tamaa ni chatu anayemeza msitu" ina maana gani?" with "maana ya maneno kama yalivyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is this really true? If not, what does the writer want us to see?
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha ya picha haina maana ya moja kwa moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not notice repetition (takriri) or rhetorical questions as devices.

example.question: "Nitarudi, nitarudi, nitarudi!" ni mbinu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Repetition looks like a mistake to a child taught not to repeat words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Nitarudi, nitarudi, nitarudi!" ni mbinu gani?" with "kosa la uchapishaji" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the line aloud; what feeling does the repetition add?
misconceptions.feedback: Takriri ni kurudia neno au kifungu ili kusisitiza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 13: Heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine)
learning_experiences: kutambua vigezo vya kimsingi katika uandishi wa insha ya maelezo,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada ya insha ya maelezo,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kutokana na kielelezo cha insha,
kuandaa vidokezo vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali panapolengwa katika insha ya maelezo,
kutumia lugha inayojenga picha ya kinachoelezewa,
kuandika insha ya maelezo inayotoa sifa za mahali akizingatia muundo ufaao na inayohusisha suala lengwa kisha awasomee wenzake darasani,
kubuni insha ya maelezo inayotoa sifa za mahali kisha awasambazie wenzake mtandaoni ili waitolee maoni,
kutolea insha za wenzake maoni kwa upendo,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi insha ya kubuni aliyoandika ili aitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vigezo vipi vinavyotumika katika kuandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kikamilifu katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha ya maelezo na kuisambaza kwa mtandao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapobuni insha ya maelezo na kumsomea mzazi/mlezi.

Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii na kitaifa: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelezo kuhusu mahali
kuandika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mahali
kuonea fahari utoaji wa maelezo kamilifu kuhusu kitu au jambo

skills.name: Andika insha ya maelezo inayodhihirisha sifa za mahali
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description or explanation with exact vocabulary, ordered paragraphs and vivid language; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi"?
example.correct_answer: Harufu ya maembe mabivu na samaki wabichi iliyajaza mabanda yaliyosongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi"?" with "Soko lilikuwa kubwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes in plain, flat words with no language devices (tashbihi, sitiari, methali, nahau) to make the insha vivid.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi"?
example.correct_answer: Harufu ya maembe mabivu na samaki wabichi iliyajaza mabanda yaliyosongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not been shown how devices from fasihi can be used in his own writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina lugha ya kiubunifu kwa insha "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi"?" with "Soko lilikuwa kubwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three devices from a class reader; rewrite one plain sentence with each.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses vague or repeated words (kitu, kizuri, sana sana) where an exact word is needed.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi"?
example.correct_answer: Harufu ya maembe mabivu na samaki wabichi iliyajaza mabanda yaliyosongamana.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he talks and has a small store of exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina msamiati ufaao kuhusu "Soko la Kongowea Asubuhi"?" with "Soko lilikuwa kubwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a theme word bank; replace every "kitu" and "kizuri" from it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia neno mahususi badala ya maneno ya jumla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali (Theme 13: Heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine)
learning_experiences: kutambua hali ya mazoea na timilifu kutoka kwenye chati, mti maneno, vitabu au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutambua ukanushaji wa sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu,
kuchagua sentensi zinazoonyesha ukanushaji wa hali ya mazoea na timilifu kutoka kwenye mchanganyiko wa sentensi kwenye vitabu, tarakilishi au chati kwa kuzikolezea wino au kuzipigia mstari,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine,
kukanusha sentensi au vifungu alivyotunga kisha awatumie wenzake kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali au kuwasomea darasani ili wazitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unapotaka kukanusha sentensi unazingatia nini?
Je, ukanushaji wa hali ya mazoea na timilifu hutofautianaje?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki shughuli za ujifunzaji na kujadiliana kuhusu ukanushaji wa hali ya mazoea na timilifu.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na kuwasambazia wenzake wazitolee maoni.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapowasambazia wenzake sentensi alizotunga katika mtandao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kuonyesha ukanushaji wa sentensi katika hali tofauti.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua ukanushaji wa hali na kuutungia sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuupambanua
kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini

skills.name: Kanusha sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu
skills.mastery: Mtoto hukanusha hali timilifu kwa ha-ja- (amefika, hajafika) na hali ya mazoea kwa kuondoa hu- (hufika, hafiki). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses hakuku- for timilifu.

example.question: Kanusha: Amefika.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hakufika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Timilifu hukanushwa kwa ha-ja-.
misconceptions.feedback: Timilifu hukanushwa kwa ha-ja-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Does not drop hu-.

example.question: Kanusha: Hufika.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hahufika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Hali ya mazoea hukanushwa kwa hafiki.
misconceptions.feedback: Hali ya mazoea hukanushwa kwa hafiki.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Wrong plural negation.

example.question: Kanusha: Wamefika.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "Hawakufika" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Wingi ni hawajafika.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi ni hawajafika.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Negates hu- with si (Si huenda) instead of the present negative (Haendi / Hawaendi).

example.question: Kanusha: "Yeye huenda sokoni kila Jumamosi."
example.wrong_answer: Yeye si huenda sokoni kila Jumamosi.

misconceptions.cause: Si is the easiest negative word and hu- has no person prefix to change.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kanusha: "Yeye huenda sokoni kila Jumamosi."" with "Yeye si huenda sokoni kila Jumamosi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: The negative of a habit uses the present negative: ha- + stem + -i.
misconceptions.feedback: Hali ya mazoea hukanushwa kwa ha-...-i: haendi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hadithi (Theme 14: Kuweka akiba)
learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya lugha kwa kusikiliza hadithi kutoka kwa mwalimu au vifaa vya kidijitali,

kuwawasilishia wenzake hadithi aliyotunga ili watambue vipengele vya lugha vilivyotumika,
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusikiliza hadithi na kutambua vipengele vya lugha vilivyotumika.

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotambua vipengele vya lugha na kuvitumia katika utambaji wa hadithi.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
