skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya lugha katika hadithi
skills.mastery: Explains the lugha of hadithi (hurafa, ngano) with the right terms and examples, gives evidence or a reason for each point, and presents one with its formula, voice, gestures and audience part (presentation scored by the teacher), in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Does not see a device of language (repetition, simile, sound words) or calls it a mistake.

example.question: "Panzi aliimba "tia tia tia"" ni kipengele gani cha lugha?

misconceptions.cause: The child has been told not to repeat words or use sounds in writing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Panzi aliimba "tia tia tia"" ni kipengele gani cha lugha?" with "kosa la lugha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read aloud; what does the device add for the listener?
misconceptions.feedback: Ni tanakali za sauti: huleta uhai na burudani
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a figure of speech literally.

example.question: "Panzi aliimba "tia tia tia"" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads words, not pictures.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Panzi aliimba "tia tia tia"" ina maana gani?" with "maana ya maneno kama yalivyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is this really true? If not, what is meant?
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha ya picha ina maana iliyofichika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names a device but cannot say why it matters (it makes the text nice).

example.question: Kipengele cha tanakali za sauti kina umuhimu gani?

misconceptions.cause: Devices are taught as labels.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kipengele cha tanakali za sauti kina umuhimu gani?" with "kinapamba tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Always add what it does: picture, rhythm, memory, stress, feeling.
misconceptions.feedback: Eleza kazi ya kipengele: kinasisitiza, kinajenga picha, kinaburudisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not see the call-and-response or the audience's part as part of the language.

example.question: Msikilizaji anaposema "Tega!" au kuitikia wimbo, hiyo ni nini?
example.correct_answer: ushirikishaji wa hadhira, sehemu ya utungo

misconceptions.cause: Written texts have no audience part.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Msikilizaji anaposema "Tega!" au kuitikia wimbo, hiyo ni nini?" with "kelele zisizo na maana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Perform it in class with and without the response; what is lost?
misconceptions.feedback: Fasihi simulizi huishirikisha hadhira.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 14: Kuweka akiba)

misconceptions.help: Two columns: wanaounga mkono / wanaopinga; fill both.
misconceptions.feedback: Mjadala una pande mbili; taja mitazamo ya pande zote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Maelekezo (Theme 14: Kuweka akiba)
learning_experiences: kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo (k.v. matumizi ya lugha, mpangilio ufaao wa maelekezo, uangavu, ubanaji),

kutambua maneno mwafaka, mpangilio mzuri wa sentensi na mpangilio sahihi wa hatua katika kielelezo cha insha ya maelekezo kutoka kwa mwalimu, kwenye maandishi (k.v. vitabu, chati) au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kuteua maneno yatakayosaidia kufanikisha maelekezo (k.v. vielezi vya mahali: kulia, kushoto; vitenzi k.v. pinda, elekea, kata; vielekezi vya kiasi: vijiko viwili, nyanya tatu),

kuandaa mpangilio ufaao wa sentensi zinazofuatana kulingana na maelekezo anayotaka kutoa (k.v. maelekezo ya mahali: Tembea hadi mwendo wa kilomita moja. Ukifika kwenye zahanati upinde kulia; maelekezo ya mapishi: weka unga vikombe vitatu kwenye bakuli, tia sukari vijiko vitano vikubwa; maelekezo ya mtihani: Jibu maswali matatu, swali la kwanza ni la lazima),
kushiriki kujadili maneno, sentensi na hatua zinazoafiki maelekezo yaliyolengwa,
kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia uteuzi mwafaka wa maneno, sentensi na hatua ili kumjengea msomaji taswira kamili ya kile kinachoelekezwa,
kuwasomea wenzake insha ya maelekezo aliyoandika au awasambazie kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unapoandika insha ya maelekezo unazingatia mambo gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kwa ufasaha na kuwasomea wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusambazia insha yake.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoteua msamiati mwafaka na mpangilio ufaao wa hatua na sentensi sahihi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitolee maoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapopewa nafasi ya kushiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo
kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu
kufurahia kuandika insha za maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelekezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelekezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes instructions with their purpose, the materials, the steps in order as commands, and safety warnings; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

misconceptions.error: Starts the steps without saying what is needed (vifaa) or what the instructions are for.

example.question: Maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuweka Akiba kwa Simu" huanza na nini?
example.wrong_answer: hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: lengo la maelekezo na vifaa vinavyohitajika

misconceptions.cause: The child goes straight to doing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuweka Akiba kwa Simu" huanza na nini?" with "hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: lengo, vifaa, hatua, tahadhari.
misconceptions.feedback: Anza kwa lengo na vifaa vinavyohitajika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells what he did in the past (Nilichukua..., nilikoroga...) instead of giving instructions (Chukua..., koroga...).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo?

misconceptions.cause: The child turns instructions into a story of his own day.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo?" with "Nilichukua sufuria nikaweka maji." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the verbs; change each to the command or -e form (chukua, weka; uchukue).
misconceptions.feedback: Maelekezo hutumia amri au hali ya kuagiza: chukua, weka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps in an order that cannot work, with no signal words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika "Jinsi ya Kuweka Akiba kwa Simu"?
example.wrong_answer: kagua salio, hamisha kiasi kidogo kila wiki, weka namba ya siri, fungua huduma ya akiba
example.correct_answer: fungua huduma ya akiba, weka namba ya siri, hamisha kiasi kidogo kila wiki, kagua salio

misconceptions.cause: The child lists steps as he remembers them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika "Jinsi ya Kuweka Akiba kwa Simu"?" with "kagua salio, hamisha kiasi kidogo kila wiki, weka namba ya siri, fungua huduma ya akiba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; add kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Fuata mpangilio wa hatua na utumie maneno ya mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out safety warnings where the task needs them.

example.question: Ni kipi kinakosekana katika maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuweka Akiba kwa Simu"?

misconceptions.cause: Warnings are not part of the steps, so they are forgotten.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi kinakosekana katika maelekezo ya "Jinsi ya Kuweka Akiba kwa Simu"?" with "anwani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask at each step: what could go wrong? Write a tahadhari.
misconceptions.feedback: Ongeza tahadhari pale panapohitajika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 14: Kuweka akiba)
learning_experiences: kutambua nomino katika hali ya udogo kwenye orodha ya nomino, chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno, sentensi, vifungu vya maneno au tarakilishi,
kutambua udogo wa maneno katika matini mbalimbali,
kuandika majina ya vifaa vya darasani katika udogo (k.v. kidawati, kijitabu),
kubadilisha nomino za hali ya wastani ziwe katika hali ya udogo,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au vifungu kwa kutumia hali ya udogo ipasavyo,
kutunga sentensi au vifungu vifupi kwa kutumia nomino katika hali ya udogo akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la kuweka akiba,
kuwasilisha kazi yake darasani ili wenzake wazitathmini,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi majina ya vitu vinavyopatikana nyumbani au shuleni katika udogo na kumtungia sentensi kwa kutumia maneno hayo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani tunayozingatia tunapotumia nomino katika udogo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kujadiliana kuhusu udogo wa nomino.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua nomino katika hali ya udogo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino katika hali ya udogo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nomino katika hali ya udogo na kuzitungia sentensi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomtajia mzazi au mlezi wake nomino katika hali ya udogo katika mazingira ya nyumbani.

skills.name: Tambua nomino katika hali ya udogo
skills.mastery: Mtoto hutambua kijiji (mji mdogo), kijiti (mti mdogo), kijumba (nyumba ndogo) na kitoto (mtoto mdogo), na kuwa ki- na kiambishi chake huonyesha udogo. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 6 small forms of ji- nouns.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong small noun.

example.question: Kijiji ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mji mkubwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kijiji ni mji mdogo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kijiji ni mji mdogo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong small noun.

example.question: Kijiti ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "mti mkubwa" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Kijiti ni mti mdogo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kijiti ni mti mdogo.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Wrong prefix for udogo.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha udogo?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes up two rules that are taught close together.
misconceptions.reveals: Offer "ji-" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new sentence.
misconceptions.help: Udogo hutumia ki-.
misconceptions.feedback: Udogo hutumia ki-.
misconceptions.source: To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

misconceptions.error: Gives the small form but keeps the agreement of the ordinary noun (kijiji kidogo is right; the child writes kitoto analia).

example.question: Jaza: Kitoto ___ (kinalia / analia).

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun and keeps the person agreement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kitoto ___ (kinalia / analia)." with "analia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Small forms move to KI-VI: kitoto kinalia, vitoto vinalia.
misconceptions.feedback: Udogo huchukua upatanisho wa KI-VI.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Usikilizaji Husishi (Theme 15: Maadili ya kijamii)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya usikilizaji husishi,
kutambua miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi ambamo usikilizaji husishi hutokea katika jamii yake,

kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika usikilizaji husishi (k.v. kuwa makini, kuuliza maswali yasiyoelekeza, kuomba ufafanuzi, kumtazama mzungumzaji, kuelewa ujumbe anaotaka kukupitishia, kumhimiza kuzungumza badala ya kutoa ushauri, kutumia ishara zifaazo) kutoka kwenye mazungumzo mafupi,
kusikiliza mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali kama vile vinasasauti na kutambua vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi vilivyozingatiwa,
kuigiza vikao rasmi vya mazungumzo, (k.v. kati ya mwalimu mkuu na mzazi kuhusu nidhamu ya mtoto) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadili vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi vilivyozingatiwa na wahusika katika mazungumzo hayo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni miktadha gani rasmi na isiyo rasmi ambapo usikilizaji husishi hutokea?
Ni vipengele gani unazingatia katika kusikiliza husishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake na kueleza kwa njia wazi miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi ambapo kusikiliza husishi hutokea.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikilizia mazungumzo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kuelezea hisia na maana za kauli za msemaji.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoeleza vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mazungumzo na mzazi au mlezi wake na kujifunza zaidi vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji; mwanafunzi anapoheshimu zamu ya wenzake katika mazungumzo.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake na kuchangia katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii na kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza matini kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya usikilizaji husishi
kutambua vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi katika matini
kujadili vipengele vya usikilizaji husishi ili kuvipambanua

skills.name: Tumia usikilizaji husishi katika mazungumzo
skills.mastery: Names the features to keep in this kind of talk (husishi), picks the better of two ways to listen or reply in a situation on rafiki aliyekosewa na wenzake, and takes part in one in standard Kiswahili, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app, 8 of 10 new items right.

misconceptions.error: Does not show he has understood (no paraphrase or question) and moves to his own story.

example.question: Mwenzako anakueleza tatizo lake. Ni jibu lipi la usikilizaji husishi?
example.wrong_answer: Hilo si kitu, mimi nilikuwa na tatizo kubwa zaidi...
example.correct_answer: Kwa hiyo unasema unahisi upweke shuleni? Pole sana.

misconceptions.cause: The child wants to share his own story.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako anakueleza tatizo lake. Ni jibu lipi la usikilizaji husishi?" with "Hilo si kitu, mimi nilikuwa na tatizo kubwa zaidi..." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise "Kwa hiyo unasema..." before any reply.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudia kwa maneno yako ulichosikia, kisha uliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Judges or advises at once instead of listening first.

example.question: Rafiki ana huzuni. Unaanza kwa?

misconceptions.cause: Advice feels like help.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki ana huzuni. Unaanza kwa?" with "Hupaswi kuhuzunika!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Listen, reflect, then ask before advising.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza kwanza bila kuhukumu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Interrupts the speaker before he finishes.

example.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child fears losing his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?" with "mkatize ili usisahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Note the idea on paper; wait for the pause.
misconceptions.feedback: Msikilize mzungumzaji hadi amalize.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Listens or speaks without looking at the other person (looks down or away).

example.question: Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?

misconceptions.cause: Looking away is a sign of respect at home for some children; in class talk it reads as not listening.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ishara ipi inaonyesha unasikiliza kwa makini?" with "kuangalia chini muda wote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise in pairs: listen with eyes on the speaker and nods; then swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Mwangalie mzungumzaji ili aone unamsikiliza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ufupisho (Theme 15: Maadili ya kijamii)
learning_experiences: kujadili vipengele vya ufupisho (k.v. habari muhimu katika aya, lugha ya anayefupisha, kudumisha mtazamo wa kifungu, idadi ya maneno),
kueleza kwa usahihi ujumbe katika kila aya kwa kutumia sentensi mojamoja,
kueleza kwa usahihi ujumbe wa aya zote za matini kwa aya moja,
kujadili kuhusu jinsi ya kuandika ufupisho wa matini,
kuandika ufupisho unaozingatia mtazamo wa matini,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi ufupisho alioufanya ili autolee maoni.

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoeleza jinsi ya kufupisha kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake jinsi ya kuandika ufupisho.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapochambua aya za matini na kutambua hoja muhimu.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.

sub_strands.sub_strand: Baruapepe ya Kiofisi (Theme 15: Maadili ya kijamii)

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika baruapepe ya kiofisi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anpomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake baruapepe ya kiofisi.

skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya baruapepe ya kiofisi

sub_strands.sub_strand: Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa (Theme 15: Maadili ya kijamii)

kujadili kanuni za kubadilisha usemi (k.v. wakati, nafsi, alama za uakifishi),
kutambua kanuni za kimsingi za kubadilisha usemi halisi kuwa usemi wa taarifa,
kubadilisha sentensi kutoka usemi halisi hadi usemi wa taarifa na usemi wa taarifa hadi usemi halisi,
kutunga sentensi za usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali likiwemo suala la maadili ya kijamii,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake sentensi alizotunga ili wazitathmini.

Unazingatia nini unapobadilisha usemi?

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahili za usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kutathmini sentensi sahili za usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa za wenzake.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuchukua nafasi mbalimbali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
